articleTitle: Optimization for PV-ESS in Distribution Network Based on CSBO
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a optimization method for photovoltaic(PV) and energy storage system(ESS). Establish an optimization model that minimizes voltage fluctuation in the distribution network, maximizes PV penetration rate, and optimizes planning costs. Due to the complexity of solving high-dimensional nonlinear multi-objective problems in the model, a Circulatory System Based Optimization (CSBO) algorithm is used to reduce the difficulty of solving. To increase the adaptability of the algorithm to model problem solving, an elite strategy selection mechanism is introduced and the algorithm is improved based on fast non dominated sorting. Finally, the entropy weight method is used to select the optimal solution. Simulation analysis shows that using the improved CSBO can obtain the optimal PV-ESS configuration scheme in the distribution network. Compared to optimizing the PV capacity first and then optimizing the ESS, the collaborative optimization method increased the PV installed capacity by 18.5% without increasing costs.

articleTitle: Application Research of Pulsed Plasma Discharge Combined Technology for the Treatment of Malodorous Gas in Sewage Pumping Station
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Pulsed plasma discharge combination technology is a new type of malodorous gas treatment process. In this paper, the application of pulsed plasma discharge combination technology in the treatment of malodorous gases in urban sewage pumping stations was studied. Pulsed plasma discharge combination technology is a combined treatment process based on pulse plasma discharge technology supplemented by filtration and adsorption layers. The pulse plasma discharge adopts a nanosecond-level narrow pulse power supply to achieve a strong pulsed electric field, the electric field intensity is adjustable, and the pollution factors in the malodorous gas are removed step by step by multi-stage discharge ionization superposition. Under the action of high-energy electric field, the pollution factors such as H2S, NH3 and hydrocarbons in malodorous gases will undergo material dissociation and free radical oxidation reactions, and the average purification efficiency of malodorous gases can reach more than 95%. This study shows that the combined technology of pulsed plasma discharge has the advantages of high removal efficiency, strong adaptability to working conditions, stable operation and no secondary pollution in the treatment of malodorous gases in urban sewage pumping stations, which is worth popularizing in similar malodorous gas treatment proj ects.

articleTitle: Research on A Controllable Reactor Realized by Multi-Winding Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Controllable reactors (CR) are general FACTS (Flexible AC Transmission System) apparatuses, which have played a crucial role in improving the power flow distribution of the system, adjusting the reactive power balance of the power grid, stabilizing the voltage, and improving the stability of the system. This paper summarizes the characteristics of various types of controllable reactors, classifies reactors with different structures, and compares different controllable reactors from the perspectives of reactance change, response speed, harmonic problem, and control accuracy. A transformer-type controllable reactor based on flux compensation is proposed, the design scheme of secondary side multi-winding is adopted to realize the large-capacity reactor, the unity of single control winding and multi-control winding in the application is expanded, and the general principle of controllable reactor is obtained through the control of the “linear two-port network” port, and the design principle of such reactor is summarized.

articleTitle: A Co-Optimization Method and Mechanism for Day-Ahead Energy Market and Reserve Market Considering VPP Participation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The combined optimization and clearing of energy market and reserve auxiliary service market can achieve the best economic benefits through meeting the constraints of safe operation and capacity limitation of the power system, which is the best practice of typical foreign spot power market operation. Following the development of energy Internet technology, flexible resources on the load side have shown great adjustment potential. It is urgent to fully mobilize the reserve potential of flexible resources on the load side. On the basis of considering the load characteristics of virtual power plant (VPP), a co-optimization method and mechanism for day-ahead energy market and reserve market considering VPP participation are proposed. It provides a mechanism basis for flexible resources like VPPs on the load side to participate in the electricity market and improve the flexibility of power system. A multi-area system composed of 3 IEEE-30 bus systems and VPPs is designed to verify the correctness and applicability of the co-optimization model. The case analysis shows that the participation of VPP can effectively reduced the reverse market cost.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on UHF Signal Propagation Characteristics of Pouring Hole of Basin-Type Insulator in GIS
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Detecting partial discharge in GIS is crucial for identifying insulation defects and improving maintenance efficiency. Conventional detection methods are insufficient to detect the internal partial discharge UHF signal in the absence of a built-in UHF sensor. Thus, detecting the UHF signal radiated from the pouring hole of the basin-type insulator is the only way to detect partial discharge in GIS by UHF technology. However, this method presents a key challenge in field verification of sensitivity of the online monitoring system for detecting partial discharge in GIS. To improve UHF detection systems and enhance detection sensitivity, this paper analyzes the characteristics of UHF signal propagation when transmitted through the pouring hole of basin-type insulators, using the theory of guided electromagnetic waves. The paper also simulates the propagation process of partial discharge UHF signals using the finite difference time-domain method, and analyzes the directivity and spectral characteristics of the electric field intensity at the pouring hole. Additionally, the paper examines the emission method of GIS external UHF electromagnetic waves and injects calibration signals through the metal-edged pouring hole on the basin-type insulator. Research findings indicate that the UHF signal's electric field is oriented along the short edge of the hole, and its main energy is concentrated between 1.9 and 2.2 GHz. The frequency spectrum trend of the sensor under internal partial discharge and external sensor injection signal is generally consistent, with external sensor injection resulting in a stronger high-frequency voltage signal compared to internal PD.

articleTitle: Frequency Stabilization Control Method for Industrial Microgrid Considering Inertia Response of Electrolytic Aluminum Load
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Faced with the challenge of maintaining system frequency stability because of the significant increase in the proportion of renewable energy on the grid, it is difficult to meet the actual frequency modulation demand by only relying on the frequency modulation response of thermal power units. With its large thermal inertia and fast response speed, incorporating electrolytic aluminum load into the frequency stability control of an industrial microgrid can improve the frequency modulation response performance. By applying inertia response control, the rapidity and flexibility of the frequency modulation response can be further improved. Meanwhile, the load power capacity is fully utilized to reduce the load power fluctuation, which guarantee the safety and stability of electrolytic aluminum production. Finally, the proposed control method is proved to be practical and effective through simulation with an industrial example.

articleTitle: Low Carbon Scheduling of Integrated Energy Systems Considering Stepped Carbon Trading and Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the in-depth reform of the energy market, making full use of demand response resources has become a factor that cannot be ignored in the low-carbon operation of integrated energy system. In this regard, a low-carbon dispatching strategy of integrated energy system considering carbon trading and dual response of supply and demand is proposed. Firstly, for the multiplicity and dispatchability of the integrated energy system, a step-type carbon trading model of the integrated energy system is constructed, and based on this, a dual-response model of supply and demand is constructed and a response compensation mechanism is proposed; secondly, for the uncertainty of renewable energy, an optimal dispatching model is established with the objective function of minimizing the sum of operation cost, demand response compensation cost and carbon trading cost. Finally, the CPLEX toolbox is used to solve the proposed model. Through different scenarios of calculations, the impact of the dual response strategy of supply and demand and the stepped carbon trading mechanism on the operation optimization of integrated energy system, energy saving and emission reduction is analyzed, and the simulation results verify the economy and low carbon of the proposed model and strategy.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling for EV Charging Stations with Varying Power Limits Based on MADDPG Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Charging behaviors of electric vehicles (EVs) are subject to a high degree of randomness, which are difficult in accurate forecast. With the growing of the number of EVs, real-time scheduling for the charging station becomes more important. By collecting real-time information of plugged-in EVs and using the Multi-agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (MADDPG) algorithm, a decentralized charging scheduling method for charging stations is proposed. Firstly, the model of the system and the energy boundary (EB) are formulated for decentralized collaborative scheduling of charging piles. Secondly, a multi-agent environment suitable for MADDPG is constructed, so that the charging pile can make the real-time charging/discharging strategies based on local information. Finally, case studies illustrate that the proposed decentralized charging scheduling method can decide scheduling strategies in real time without relying on forecast information of EVs, effectively reducing charging costs and responding to changes in operating scenarios.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Optimal Scheduling of Electricity-Heat Microgrid Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at the influence of fluctuation and randomness of new energy on microgrid operation, a microgrid system with multiple new energy power generation and energy coupling equipment is constructed, and an optimal scheduling strategy of electric heating microgrid considering demand response is proposed. Firstly, the mathematical model of each device is constructed. Secondly, the demand response is used to guide users to actively participate in load adjustment, so as to smooth the load curve. On this basis, a day-ahead optimal scheduling model is established with the objective of minimizing total operation cost. The simulation results show that the strategy can effectively improve the operational economy of microgrid.

articleTitle: Fast Load Recovery Optimization Method After Under Frequency Load Shedding Considering Demand-Side Resources
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Load shedding is an emergency measure in power systems, but the recovery time after a load shedding event is often quite long. To reduce the adverse effects on users caused by under frequency load shedding(UFLS), this paper proposes an optimized scheduling model for load recovery after UFLS, which considers demand-side resources and aims to maximize load recovery while minimizing recovery time. The model also provides a method for linearizing nonlinear constraints. By introducing the demand response of loads into the load recovery process after load shedding and adjusting the demand-side resources downward, the model provides more space for load recovery, thereby improving the efficiency of load recovery and reducing the adverse effects of power outages on users. The IEEE-33 node system was used for case study verification, and the results showed that the proposed model can provide load restoration plans that ensure frequency dynamic security, with a fast recovery speed.

articleTitle: CVaR-Based Offering Strategy for Price-Maker Wind-Storage Unit in Day-Ahead Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Joint operation of wind power producer (WPP) with battery energy storage system (BESS) is being widely used to mitigate the negative effects of uncertainty in the output of wind power. To investigate the impact of BESS on the bidding strategy of a WPP in a day-ahead (DA) electricity market, a bi-level optimization model is developed for a price-maker WPP equipped with BESS (WPP-BESS unit) to determine its optimal offering strategy in the DA market. In this model, the WPP-BESS unit's bid deviation is penalized according to the real-time (RT) market prices, and the conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) is used to tackle the uncertainties in the RT market prices and wind power outputs. At the upper level, the WPP-BESS unit decides its offering strategy to maximize its utility which comprises the expected profit and CVaR. At the lower level, the independent system operator (ISO) performs the DA market clearing to minimize the system operating cost. Finally, the case studies verify the effectiveness of the model. It is shown that, WPP equipped with BESS can effectively reduce its bid deviation and risk when participating in the DA market.

articleTitle: Two-Dimensional Information Entropy Infrared Image Threshold Segmentation Based on the Bat Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Infrared Image ROI (Area of Interest) Segmentation is one of the key steps of infrared fault intelligent diagnosis of electrical devices. Aiming at the problem of difficult and time-consuming threshold selection in the segmentation process, a two-dimensional information entropy infrared image threshold segmentation based on the bat algorithm is proposed. By analyzing the two-dimensional information entropy threshold segmentation principle, the bat algorithm was introduced to quickly search for the optimal segmentation threshold and perform the threshold segmentation experiment on the infrared image of the electrical device. The results show that this method not only improved the image segmentation effect, but also greatly increased the threshold selection speed compared to the particle swarm OTSU method (PSO+Otsu), Kapur threshold segmentation method and Kittler minimum error method, laying a foundation for the subsequent extraction and analysis of temperature field features of the device.

articleTitle: Analysis of IGBT Reliability Considering Bonding Line Fault
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) is the core component of the widely used power converter. IGBT is the most fragile device in the converter, and the fault of bond wire will cause IGBT aging failure. In this paper, the influence of overload current applied on IGBT bonding wire and bonding wire shedding on the reliability of IGBT module is analyzed in ANSYS. The results show that when overload current is applied or bonding wire falls off, the overall temperature of the module will increase or even exceed the maximum allowable temperature, resulting in a decrease in the reliability level of IGBT, which will cause module failure in severe cases.

articleTitle: Analysis of Short-Term Voltage Stability Influencing Factors and Mechanisms in Low Inertia Active Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Driven by the call for low-carbon operation of distribution networks, the penetration of renewable energy sources and dynamic loads keeps increasing, which also critically lowered the inertia of the whole system and stressed the short-term voltage stability (STVS) issue. Due to the high-order and nonlinear nature of the system nature, however, STVS is conventionally evaluated by a black-box model either via time-domain simulations or learning approaches. Hence, mathematical analytics are absent, thus making the investigation of STVS mechanism technically intractable to date. This paper attempts to investigate the mechanism of STVS in active distribution networks with respect to loading level, network structure and renewable energy generation. A procedure to identify the key influencing factors of STVS based on an attribution analysis model is proposed. And the impact and distribution of critical nodes on STVS are discovered. The analysis is verified via case studies on an IEEE standard benchmark.

articleTitle: Market-Oriented Clean Energy Consumption Based on Source-Grid-Load-Storage Interaction
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The development of clean energy and low carbon is an urgent requirement for sustainable development of national economy and compliance with international climate change. Against the background of China's steady implementation of the promotion of dual carbon, the power industry is still facing prominent problems. The complementarity of multiple energy sources is obviously insufficient, which seriously restricts the sustainable and healthy development of clean energy. By using the integrated technology of “source, network, load and storage”, strengthen the interactive management of “source, network, load and storage”, promote the transformation of the power grid from the traditional single power supply to the load change mode of “source, network, load and storage”, and help realize the local consumption of market-oriented clean energy.

articleTitle: Health Status Monitoring Technology for Transmission Tower Structures and its Application in Background of Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Under the background of energy internet, the accuracy of state parameters sensing for power equipment condition assessment is required to be higher and higher. To grasp the health status of overage transmission tower structures in real time, this paper built a wireless sensor network-based structural health status monitoring system for 4 transmission towers currently in operation in Linyi, Shandong Province. The control parts and damage-sensitive parts of the tower structures were determined by finite-element analysis. The working stress, deformation, and vibration of the structures, foundation displacement and settlement, and other information about the health status of the structures were thereby monitored online in real time. The results show that the proposed monitoring system operates well and the monitored data on the strain, vibration, and settlement fluctuate steadily. Moreover, the health status of the tower structures exhibits no abnormality. In this way, the proposed system effectively guarantees the safe and stable operation of the transmission towers.

articleTitle: Study on Ampacity Improvement of ± 500 kV HVDC Submarine Cable Under Land Laying Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Submarine cables are an important component of offshore wind power, and its ampacity is directly proportional to power efficiency. The temperature of the submarine cable rises after landing due to unfavorable thermal conditions, which causes the land part of the submarine cable to become a bottleneck in ampacity. To address this bottleneck, this work uses FEM to create the ±500kV DC submarine cable in a land laying environment. Firstly, the better backfill material for the cable trenches is studied by comparing the heat transfer effect of different materials. On this basis, the effect of equipping a cooling circulating water system for further heat dissipation is analyzed, and tube parameters are designed. To validate the above scheme, this paper finally compares the ampacity of this scheme and direct burial under different working conditions. Results show that the scheme can improve the ampacity by about 54.1% at ordinary temperature. Therefore, the scheme in this paper can effectively improve the bottleneck of submarine cables in the land and provide guidance for improving the ampacity.

articleTitle: A Data-driven Technique Based on Power System Reliability Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Power system reliability assessment is critical to ensure the safety of power systems. This paper proposed a method to quantitatively assess the risk of power systems using Bayesian networks. Based on the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation (FCE) method, indicators and importance weights for power system reliability assessment are established, indicators that may pose an impact on power system reliability are measured quantitatively, and finally, power system reliability is rated according to the evaluation matrix and indicator weights. The risk of the whole power system was evaluated by using the historical data of power system reliability. The results of the study can provide a theoretical basis for power system design, prevention and reduction of system accidents, and a reference for improving the reliability of power systems.

articleTitle: Bi-Level Optimization Model for Customer Directrix Load-Based Demand Response in Industrial Parks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Customer directrix load (CDL)-based demand response (CDL-DR) program has the advantages of large-scale and easy implementation, which exhibits large potentials to improve the flexibility of power systems. When conducting CDL-DR program for load aggregators (LAs) in an industrial park (IP), it is necessary for the IP operator to design reasonable incentive to guide LAs to actively adjust their load curves according to the CDL. To solve this problem, we develop a bi-level optimization model for the IP operator to determine the incentive for LAs' CDL-DR. At the upper level, the IP operator sets the incentive prices according to the Euclidean distances between the LAs' load curves and the CDL, aiming to minimize its operation cost. In the lower level, the LAs adjust their power consumptions according to the incentive prices to maximize their profits. Numerical simulation is presented to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Double Closed-Loop Control Strategy for Photovoltaic Inverter Based on Improved Average Current Control
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at the resonance peak problem existing in the LCL type three-phase photovoltaic inverter grid-connected system, this paper proposes a dual current control method combining capacitive current feedback and average current control. By introducing the capacitive current feedback link in the weighted average current outer loop to form a double closed-loop control method to suppress the resonance peak problem of the LCL filter, so as to improve the grid-connected current quality. However, due to the fluctuation of the output power of new energy sources, the voltage outer loop is introduced on the basis of the double closed-loop current control strategy. The current inner loop is used to track the capacitor current and the weighted average value of the grid side current and the inverter side current, and the voltage outer loop is used to control the stability of the DC side input voltage of the inverter. The simulation results show that the harmonic distortion rate of grid-connected current is reduced from 4.37% to 0.78<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, which proves the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Method for HVDC Location Evaluation Based on Multi-Objective Fuzzy Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In the planning stage of multi-HVDC system, in order to improve the DC transmission capacity, the impact of imperfectness of the grid during transition period needs to be considered. The paper analyzes the mechanism by which the DC transmission capacity is affected by the DC short-circuit ratio, thermal stability, and voltage stability after AC/DC faults. Accordingly, four indicators, namely DC power pooling channel adequacy, evacuation capability of power flow channels under DC fault, DC short-circuit ratio, and voltage security after DC fault, are designed respectively to reflect the security and stability of the system after fault. On this basis, a DC planning location selection method based on fuzzy decision-making is proposed. The correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by the evaluation of three alternative locations for Jin-Shang HVDC in southwest power grid of China.

articleTitle: Conductor Galloping Forecasting via Meterological Data
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Conductor galloping may cause electric and mechanical damage to overhead transmission lines. With the aim of dealing the galloping issue in advance, it is necessary to develop a method to forecast the galloping behavior of conductors. In this paper, the threshold for identification of galloping days, as well as the duration of potential galloping weather conditions are employed to predict the servility of power grid. Finally, the galloping event happened in Jilin province, China in Nov. 2020 has been forecasted successfully.

articleTitle: Output Prediction of Kmedoids-BiGRU-DTW Distributed Photovoltaic Cluster based on Similar Days
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the gradual increase of distributed photovoltaic permeability, accurate prediction of its output is conducive to the safety and stability of photovoltaic grid connection. At present, there are some problems in the cluster prediction methods based on the traditional statistical upscaling method, such as the inconsistency of power output characteristics and the unreasonable selection of weight coefficients. This paper proposes an improved statistical upscaling modeling method for PV cluster output prediction based on PCA-Kmedoids cluster partition. Aiming at the inconsistent output characteristics of PV power stations in the subset group of the traditional statistical upscaling method, Pearson correlation coefficient and PCA were used to optimize the feature space, and then cluster PV power stations within the region according to the Kmedoids clustering model, to enhance the consistency of cluster output characteristics of PV power stations after clustering. A similar day selection algorithm based on DTW was proposed to aim at the problem of extracting and predicting the dynamic characteristics of the time series of the weight coefficients of the days to be predicted. Finally, the BiGRU PV prediction model is used to predict the output of representative power stations. The results show that the MAPE of the cluster prediction method is about 5.41%, and the RMSE is about 0.6.

articleTitle: Economic Operation of Power Distribution Networks under Coordinated Operation of Source-network-load-storage
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The coordinated optimal operation of source-grid-load-storage is crucial in reducing the operation cost of the power system, as well as in absorbing more new energy. However, previous studies on optimal scheduling of energy storages only considered charge-discharge constraints and state-of-charge constraints, with limited discussions on life and cost models. As a result, they overlooked the deployment cost of energy storage resources. This paper combines the operating income and subsidy income of energy storage and realizes the coordination and interaction of source, grid, load, and storage through load aggregators. The simulation results of different scenarios demonstrate that the coordination and optimization of source-grid-load-storage can significantly reduce the fluctuation range of load and realize the reduction of power grid operation cost.

articleTitle: Source Network Planning of Distribution Network Considering Carbon Emission Cost
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the increasing concern over climate change and the escalating impact of extreme weather events, the need for carbon emission reduction becomes increasingly critical. In light of this, this paper addresses the power system planning problem and presents a two-layer programming model that incorporates carbon emission costs. Additionally, a corresponding solution method is proposed to tackle this problem. Through the comparison of various scenarios, the proposed model's efficacy has been demonstrated, showcasing its economic value and social benefits in terms of carbon reduction.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Sharing-Based Coordinating Operation of Multiple Photovoltaic Stations with ADMM
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The rapid growth of photovoltaic (PV) installations has resulted in an imbalance between generation and demand, leading to difficulties in accommodating and utilizing the generated electricity effectively. To address this issue, this paper proposes an energy storage sharing-based coordinating operation framework for multiple PV stations to fully utilization of energy storage and enhance the overall efficiency of PV. In this study, we consider the operating costs of energy storage and PV, and propose a strategy for the coordinated operation of multiple PV stations based on energy storage sharing. Furthermore, we solve the model using the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) and derive the energy sharing strategy and optimal cost allocation of multiple PVs under the concept of sharing through iterative calculations. Finally, we present simulation results that verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy in terms of the economic efficiency of multiple PVs based on energy storage sharing.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Optimal Scheduling of Multi-Energy System Considering Hybrid Pumped-Battery Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Multi-energy complementary systems are a promising solution for the integration of diverse energy sources, serving as a vital means to embrace renewable energy. Nevertheless, its intricate internal energy composition within it present significant hurdles when aiming for optimal optimization. Given the natural complementary characteristics of different sources, wind power, solar power, hydropower, lithium battery storage and pumped storage are taken as an essential component of a complementary power generation system. Using the aforementioned framework, a day-ahead optimization model is established, considering various power constraints. This work core aim is to diminish the output power fluctuations of the complementary system, then the optimal model is subsequently solved by the particle swarm intelligent optimization algorithm. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed model effectively tracks the desired objectives, mitigates the impact of variable wind and solar power on the electrical power system, boosts the usage of renewable energy, reduces curtailment of wind and solar power, and offers significant environmental benefits.

articleTitle: Load Frequency Stabilization Control and Parameter Optimization Method in Isolated Electrolytic Aluminum Industrial Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Electrolytic aluminum (EA) loads has a large capacity, strong energy storage and fast response characteristics, which can be used as a high-quality resource to consume renewable energy and achieve flexible grid frequency regulation (FR). To improve the frequency stability of isolated power grids for EA, a frequency stabilization control and parameter optimization method considering the load's flexible regulation capability are proposed in this article. The proposed method takes into account the dynamic response characteristics and regulation capacity limit of EA load. Based on frequency deviation information, the FR parameter is adaptively selected, which can make full use of the load's flexible adjustable capacity, while avoiding over-regulation. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method can effectively improve the frequency response performance.

articleTitle: Energy Price-Driven Integrated Demand Response for Optimal Operation of Multi-Carrier Energy Systems with Hydrogen Facility
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of the Chinese national “dual carbon” strategic goal, the green and low-carbon transformation of the multi-carrier energy system (MES) is an important path to achieve this goal. In order to fully explore the integrated demand response (IDR) ability of the MES and the influence of hydrogen utilization on the system optimal scheduling, this paper proposes an economically low-carbon cooperative optimization operation strategy for hydrogen-containing electric-thermal MES driven by energy price. Firstly, a hydrogen facility composed of electrolyzer (EL), fuel cell (FC) and hydrogen storage tank (HST) is constructed. Secondly, a MES model based on price elasticity matrix is established. Finally, with the objective of minimizing the operation costs, the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is verified by different scenarios' simulation using MATLAB and Gurobi optimization solver. Through the analysis of the system operating status under different scenarios, it is found that IDR can achieve economically, low-carbon, and efficient operation of MES. The introduction of a hydrogen utilization system can improve energy utilization efficiency and enhance the system's operational flexibility.

articleTitle: Speed Control Strategy for DTP-PMSM Based on Leading Angle Flux-Weakening
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the advancements in power electronics technology and motor control theory, multi-phase motors are now more prominent due to their higher power density and efficiency. Among these motors, dual three-phase permanent magnet synchronous motors (DTP-PMSM) have substantial potential for applications in wind power generation, electric vehicles, and aerospace due to their high efficiency and reliability. The paper starts by establishing a mathematical model for DTP-PMSM, considering the effects of motor torque and speed based on the structural characteristics of the motor. It also investigates the principle of weak field in the leading angle. The vector control method, specifically segmented vector control, is chosen for controlling the DTP-PMSM. Below the base speed, the id=0 control method is utilized, while above the base speed overrun angle, the regulator exits saturation in the weak magnetic loop and enters the weak magnetic operating area. A speed acceleration strategy is subsequently proposed employing a dual vector six-phase motor space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) technique by redistributing the current on the d-axis and q-axis. To validate the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method, simulations are conducted in MATLAB/Simulink.

Author Keywords: Dual Three-Phase Permanent-magnet Synchrono us Motor

articleTitle: Research on the Optimization Strategy of Electric Vehicle Charging and Discharging Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the rapid growth of electric vehicle ownership and the continuous increase of its charging volume, a linear programming-based electric vehicle charging scheduling optimization strategy was proposed on the basis of Vehicle To Grid(V2G) to address the problems of high charging costs and large load fluctuations of the power system in charging stations. With the objective of minimizing the total charging cost of the charging station, the daily driving demand of EVs and the load constraint of the grid were considered, and the Linprog solver function in Matlab was used to obtain the charging power of EVs at each moment, so as to further obtain the total charging power of the charging station at each moment and solve for the optimal charging cost. Through experimental simulation analysis, the optimal charging strategy proposed in this paper effectively reduced the total charging cost of the charging station and can achieve the purpose of EV charging and discharging scheduling optimization.

articleTitle: Research on the New Technology of Uninterruptible Electric Ice Melting in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: To deal with the icing of overhead lines caused by frequent ice disasters, this subject proposes a new uninterruptible electric ice-melting technology for distribution network. The deicing device is composed of adjustable reactor and earthing transformer. The head end of the device is connected to the substation power supply through a transformer, and the end is short-circuited with one-phase line in the ice- covered section through a ground wire to form a zero-sequence circuit, so as to provide zero-sequence current to the line to be deiced online to make the line heat up and melt the ice to achieve deicing without power outage. After the article puts forward this scheme, the model was built in Maxwell 3D software for verification, and the ice melting test is carried out on the pilot line, which proves the feasibility of this scheme.

articleTitle: Low-carbon Economic Dispatch of Industrial Integrated Energy Systems Considering Both Reliability and Resilience
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Random equipment failures and natural disasters can cause energy supply constraints in the system and impact how normal customers are served. This study builds a framework for low-carbon economic dispatch optimization for industrial integrated energy systems accounting for the effects of random equipment failures and interruptions in energy supply brought by external natural disasters. By adding reliability and resilience constraints to the low-carbon economic operation optimization model, the energy interruption scenarios are discussed. Under the scenario of limited energy supply, the rise in some economic costs brought on by continuing operations is balanced off by the system economy as a whole. Moreover, the numerical analysis shows that it is possible to significantly increase the system's resilience to energy supply disruption at the expense of the economic benefits.

articleTitle: Fatigue Life Assessment of the Inflective Arm Roller in High-voltage Switch Spring Operating Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Spring operating mechanism (SOM) failures are the main cause of circuit breaker failures, and the reliability issues of widely used SOM have always been a challenging research topic in the high-voltage circuit field. This paper proposes a combined approach of simulation and experimentation, taking a spring operating mechanism currently under development by a certain company as an example. The objective is to address the reliability issues by employing an integrated experimental and simulation method and conducting a fatigue life assessment of the vulnerable component, the inflective arm roller, using a modal stress recovery-based approach. On one hand, the stiffness, mass, and damping characteristics of the structure are obtained through modal analysis of the finite element model, which provides the structural stress distribution. On the other hand, by establishing a coupled dynamic model of the entire spring operating mechanism and validating it through experiments, the load spectra of the roller during the closing process are obtained, effectively reducing the uncertainty in fatigue life prediction and fatigue test costs while improving the reliability of spring operating mechanisms.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimal Control Method of Reactive Voltage Based on Multi-Cycle Coordination for Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an optimal control method of the multi-cycle coordinated reactive voltage for the power grid. The OLTC model and compensation equipment model for the reactive power are established, and the aim of optimal control method is to reduce the power grid losses. By transforming the original nonlinear relaxation into second-order cone constraints, coordination and fine adjustment of discrete and continuous regulation equipment optimization are achieved, and real-time voltage exceeding limits are corrected. The typical power grid was taken as an example for analysis, the amplitude of voltage fluctuations have been reduced, the numbers of voltage regulation equipment actions have been reduced, and the reactive voltages of the power grid have been effectively optimized.

articleTitle: Study on Lightning Backlash Trip Rate and Lightning Resistance Level After AC to DC Operation of Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: After the transmission line changed from AC to DC operation, The tower foundations and conductors of the original AC line are generally not replaced, but are only changed to DC by relocating the conductors and grounding devices. the line lightning attraction capability as well as the lightning protection level changed due to the change in the spatial electric field. In this study, ATP-EMTP simulation software was used to model AC and DC transmission lines under the same lightning protection measures, and the differences in lightning resistance levels and lightning strike trip rates between the two when subjected to lightning strikes back on the towers were compared through simulation analysis. The simulation results show that compared with AC operation, the lightning resistance level of DC transmission lines is reduced by 10.2% and the lightning strike trip rate is significantly reduced by 19.97%, reducing the tower grounding resistance plays an important role in improving the lightning resistance level of AC to DC transmission lines and the lightning strike trip rate, and the lightning resistance level and trip rate of AC and DC operation transmission lines with tower grounding resistance of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1-5\Omega$</tex> are rate have reached a high safety level.

articleTitle: Modal Power Analysis of Complex Circuit for Grid-Connected Converters with Arbitrary Power Factor
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: When the renewable energy is connected to the weak ac grids, the converter usually needs to operate under non unit power factor to provide reactive power support to the grid, so as to improve the voltage quality of the grid connection point. In order to analyze the stability of grid-connected converter system under non unit power factor conditions, firstly, the primal-dual complex circuit of the system is obtained based on the polar frame impedance modeling, and the modal power of each generalized admittance is calculated. Secondly, the stability of the system is analyzed according to the stability determination method of modal power, the results indicate that modal power is suitable for judging the stability of grid-connected converters with arbitrary power factor. According to the characteristics of the modal power, the influence of the generalized admittance on the oscillation mode is judged, and the critical circuit affecting the system oscillation is divided. Finally, the theoretical analysis results under different control parameters and different power factors are verified by MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Profit and Loss of Pumped Storage Units Participating in Spot Market
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Under the new electricity price policy mechanism, China's pumped storage units will enter the spot market to participate in mediation and profit. At present, pumped storage units are strictly managed by dispatching orders. This paper establishes a profit model of pumped storage units in the spot market under the call on demand mode. By integrating their power and electricity curves and real-time price curves, the operation simulation of pumped storage units participating in the spot market under the call on demand mode is carried out. The results indicate that under the normal electricity price trend curve, pumped storage units have a certain profitability when operating according to the conventional pumping and power generation timing. However, under reverse electricity price conditions, they will face a greater risk of losses. Improving the autonomy of unit power regulation is an effective way to reduce losses.

articleTitle: Localization Method of Multi-Source Abnormal Sound Signals of Power Equipment Based on GMUSIC
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The safety and stability of power equipment in the substation are critical for the power grid. Whether the equipment in an abnormal state could be analyzed by the change of audible sound characteristics which contains abundant operation information. Furthermore, the localization of abnormal sound sources can determine whether the equipment part has a potential defect. In practical applications, because of the requirements for accuracy and real-time performance, large arrays and small snapshots are most used as the detection system. It leads to the failure of the traditional localization method, especially for multiple sound sources with a similar angle. However, there are usually multiple sound sources in substations when detecting abnormal sound for power equipment. Therefore, a sound source localization method based on a uniform planar matrix and GMUSIC algorithm was proposed. The sample covariance matrix and corresponding spatial spectrum of raw sound data are built, and then the source can be located by searching the spectral peak of the spatial spectrum. The field tests indicate that the proposed method can resolve adjacent sound sources with fewer snapshots, and the localization success rate was highly improved.

articleTitle: A Novel Neural Network Structure for Electricity Load Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Electricity load prediction is a critical task in the energy industry, as it helps to ensure a stable and reliable power supply. Accurate load forecasting enables energy companies to optimize their operations, reduce costs, and improve overall efficiency. However, traditional methods for load prediction, such as statistical models and traditional machine learning techniques, are often limited by their accuracy and computational efficiency. This article proposes a Temporal Fusion Transformer Modified structure for electricity load prediction using the Australian Energy Market Operator (AEMO) dataset. The proposed model outperforms traditional methods such as LSTM and machine learning techniques and achieves improved accuracy and efficiency. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach and its potential for practical applications in the electricity industry.

articleTitle: Impacts of Hydrogen Mixed Gas Turbines on Emissions under Different Penetrations of Wind Power and Solar Power
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The integrated electrical and natural gas system is a significant part of the energy system. With the demand for the low carbon targets of energy systems, the hydrogen-blended combustion power generation technology of the gas turbine came into being. To this end, this paper proposes a dispatch method of the integrated electrical and natural gas system to explore the environmental implications of hydrogen mixed gas turbines under a range of different renewable penetration levels, and Hydrogen is provided for hydrogen mixed gas turbines by electrolytic water technology and configures hydrogen storage tanks and gas storage tanks as a consortium to provide backup for the system. The piecewise linearization method is used to linearly transform the Weymouth equation, and the non-convex non-linear model is transformed into a mixed integer linear programming model. The effectiveness and feasibility of this method are verified. The operation state of the system under different scenarios is analyzed. The deep exploration of renewable accommodation potential in the mode of wind power and photovoltaic-electrochemical water splitting-hydrogen mixed gas turbines is realized.

Author Keywords: integrated electrical and natural gas system

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network-Based Load Characterization Technique for Electricity Customer Tapping
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Today, China's economic development is very rapid, so industrial production and social life put forward higher requirements for the quality of electrical energy. The effective identification of electric customer load can facilitate the staff to grasp the operational changes of electric load in real time, so as to realize the scientific monitoring of electric power system. Therefore, this paper proposes a load identification technology based on convolutional neural network, which firstly extracts load features by convolutional neural network model and then performs clustering analysis by supervised learning, and at the same time compares the identification accuracy of various convolutional neural network models to obtain a network model with high accuracy.

articleTitle: The Review of Smart Material Supply Chain Construction of Power Grid Enterprises in Background of Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Under the background of energy internet, the demand for the intelligence of the supply chain of power grid enterprises is becoming higher and higher. We can fully understand the function of the material supply chain through systematically analysis of it; We use the theory and method of modular architecture to build an intelligent material supply chain. This paper firstly analyzes material supply chain management status in power grid enterprises; Secondly, it analyzes the construction requirements of the four functions of operation monitoring, resource allocation, emergency support and intelligent decision-making, and puts forward the construction plan; Finally, based on the above construction planning, the material supply support capacity of power grid enterprises will be comprehensively improved.

articleTitle: The Impact of Parameters on Coordinated Frequency Regulation of New Energy Station Based on VSG
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Based on the inertia support and prime frequency regulation capability of new energy station, this article builds the average frequency responsive model of the power system composed of synchronous generators and new energy stations. The main control parameters of new energy station are proposed and analyzed to make sure the system is stable. Through simulation and analysis, it can be seen that the timing and degree of participation of the new energy station in the primary frequency regulation could be designed in accordance with the dead zone. Additionally, the primary frequency modulation time constant value determines the frequency modulation speed and eliminates the power oscillation at the dead zone boundary. Finally, by combining several sets of parameters, the desired primary frequency regulation performance and timing can be achieved.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Stability Control System Based on Device and Communication Failures
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The stability control system is a facility critical for the power grid operating safely and stably in the event of severe faults. The failure of its devices or communication channels can impact on the operation of the power grid seriously. Based on analysis of the business functions and control architecture of the stability control system, a stable control system modeling and risk quantification evaluation method based on control strategies has been proposed. Firstly, a logical correlation model for the stability control system and communication network is constructed. Then, a quantitative evaluation method of stability control system risk based on strategic control quantity is proposed. Finally, based on a typical power grid scenario, the rationality and usability of the method were analyzed and verified.

articleTitle: Ultra Short Term Power Forecasting of Wind Generation Based on Improved LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In response to the characteristics of intermittent, high variability, and strong randomness in wind power output, A multi-layer stacked bidirectional LSTM (MBLSTM) with Temporal Pattern Attention(TPA) mechanism is proposed as a forecasting method for wind power. Firstly, clean up the dataset using a combination of DBSCAN algorithm and linear threshold method; Secondly, based on the TPA mechanism, the complex correlation between features is extracted from the hidden row vectors obtained from the MBLSTM network, and the forecasting precision is enhanced by reasonable allocation of weights at different time steps. Finally, experimental simulation data proves that the proposed approach demonstrates significant efficacy in enhancing the precision of ultra short-term power forecasting.

articleTitle: Coordinated Fault-Ride-Through Strategy of Modular Multilevel Matrix Converter in Low-Frequency AC Transmission System for Offshore Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The offshore low-frequency AC transmission (LFAC) has high power electronic characteristics, and unable to satisfy the grid-connected requirements of the system only by the single-side crossing control of the wind turbine. In this paper, a coordinated fault ride-through (FRT) strategy of Modular Multilevel Matrix Converter-Permanent Magnet Synchronous Generators (M3C-PMSG) for different fault degrees is proposed to achieve hierarchical FRT. Primarily, the model of M3C is analyzed, and the control of M3C is optimized by means of filter circuit. Secondly, based on the performance of the LFAC, the change of M3C unbalanced power during the fault is revealed. Subsequently, according to the characteristics of system voltage and power change, M3C remote control PMSG is set to reduce output and maintain the system operation stability. Finally, the LFAC simulation model based on M3C is built in PSCAD. The FRT capability of the system is verified for different fault conditions, which proves the feasibility and effectiveness of the control strategy in this paper.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Electricity-Gas Coupling System Considering Failure Correlation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: A new approach is suggested to assess the reliability of an electricity-gas coupling system (EGCS) that considers failure correlation, in order to make the reliability evaluation results more practical. To deal with the nonlinear problem of the transient equations of natural gas system, the method of characteristics (MOC) is employed to linearize it and participate in the reliability evaluation. Comparing the content proposed in this article with the traditional reliability assessment process, the results indicate that considering failure correlation has a significant influence on the reliability evaluation results.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Bidding Strategy of Load Aggregators Based on Incentive Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Load aggregators (LAs) play a crucial role in demand response (DR) programs by enabling large energy consumers to participate in the electricity market. Incentive demand response is a type of DR that motivates consumers to reduce their energy consumption by providing them with economic incentives. This paper proposes a day-ahead bidding strategy for LAs, which allows them to optimize their bidding decisions in response to the price signals provided by the market operator. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy, simulation experiments are conducted on a realistic power system model. Therefore, the proposed strategy can be used as a useful tool for LAs to participate in incentive demand response and maximize their economic benefits.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimal Power Management for All-Electric Marine Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: To build more efficient and environmentally friendly ships, electrification of the ship power systems is a better choice. In the ship microgrid, the hybrid energy storage system (HESS) can better meet the variation of shipload and facilitate the operation of all-electric ships (AES). To reduce fuel consumption cost, limit greenhouse gas emissions, and improve overall ship operation efficiency, this paper analyzes the problem of optimizing the operation of a ship power system consisting of an all-electric propulsion system and HESS and proposes a two-step multi-objective optimization method of HESS management. The first step is to integrate the HESS into the ship-board power system, and use the HESS to regulate the ship-board generator output to achieve the optimization of economic and environmental protection objectives simultaneously; the second step is to use the parameter optimization-based variation modal decomposition (VMD) algorithm to decompose the output of the HESS and complete the reasonable power distribution between lithium batteries and high-power type energy storage devices.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Control Strategy for Building Air Conditioning Participating in Power Grid Operation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The research shows that large-scale building air conditioning can take into account the comfort of energy consumption while participating in power grid regulation, and has become an important flexible controllable resource for power grid peak regulation in summer. Therefore, this paper constructs an adaptive control strategy model for large-scale building air conditioning to participate in power grid operation with the goal of economic optimization and uses the multi-population genetic algorithm to solve it. Then, considering the factors such as time and capacity, the multi-dimensional accurate evaluation system is proposed and the attribute interval recognition method is used to complete the post-evaluation of the implementation effect of building air conditioning. Finally, the scenario assumes that the air-conditioning load of buildings participates in the actual situation of power grid regulation. Through the selection of adaptive control strategies in different scenarios under three different objectives: economic operation, participating users and temperature comfort, the superiority of the proposed strategy is analyzed and obtained, thus verifying the effectiveness and rationality of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A DFT Study on Structural, Electronic and Optical Properties of La and N co-doped BaTiO3
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In recent years, BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>has garnered significant attention in research due to its remarkable ability to photocatalytic hydrogen generation. While the fundamental principles, particularly at the molecular level, remain poorly understood, the majority of studies have concentrated on experimental techniques to increase its photocatalytic effectiveness. Our focus in this study is to explore the electronic and optical properties the electronic and optical properties of La+N co-doped BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>perovskite. A structure of La and N doped BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> was built, and it was then optimized in CASTEP using the GGA-PBE functional with a cutoff energy of 500 eV. Subsequently, the geometric optimization parameters, electronic structure, and optical properties were computed. According to our research, co-doped BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>with La+N produces an intermediate state that efficiently lowers the band gap to 1.661 eV. This intermediate state acts as a “springboard” by reducing the energy of the electron transition. The DOS diagram further reveals that the hybridization of N-2p and O-2p is the primary cause of the intermediate state. Additionally, our analysis of the optical characteristics shows that La+N co-doping causes a new absorption peak to appear at 450 nm and extends the absorption edge of BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>into the visible spectrum. Overall, our work offers theoretical support for the future investigation of the photophysical properties of BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>perovskite doped with rare earth elements and non-metallic elements.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Performance of Main Transformer Fire Extinguishing System in UHV Substation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to verify the performance of the main transformer fire extinguishing system in UHV substation, considering the unfavorable factors such as fire explosion, occlusion and oil temperature, based on the real fire experimental platform of UHV AC transformer, the full-scale fire extinguishing experiment of water spray fire extinguishing system is carried out. The results show that the water spray fire extinguishing system can better realize the full envelope of the transformer body under the condition of 30L/min·m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. In the process of continuous envelope of water spray fire extinguishing system, it can effectively inhibit fire development or extinguish fire. In the design of the water spray nozzle, the full envelope of the flowing fire in the transformer body and the bottom oil pool should be considered at the same time. The experiment verifies the effectiveness of the water spray fire extinguishing scheme, and investigates the influence of supply intensity and other factors on the fire extinguishing performance, which provides experimental support for the typical technical scheme of fire protection improvement in the main transformer area of UHV substation.

articleTitle: An Integrated Evaluation Method for Energy Systems in Green Industrial Parks Based on Carbon Emission
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: An integrated evaluation method of a green industrial park energy system based on carbon emission is proposed. Firstly, the evaluation index system of the method constructs two dimensions of equipment and benefit, as well as three levels of indicators to evaluate the park. Secondly, the implementation process of the proposed evaluation method includes: 1) using the K-means algorithm to cluster different parks based on two dimensions of industrial type and park size; 2) proposing an underlying index scoring algorithm to score each index of the park to reflect the development level of the park energy system among similar parks; 3) combining the advantages of analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and entropy weight method (EWM) to assign weights to each index to reduce the subjectivity and complexity of weight assignment; 4) using the fuzzy integrated evaluation method to quantitatively assess the development level of energy systems in the dimensions of “equipment” and “benefit”. Finally, the effectiveness and rationality of the proposed method for the integrated evaluation of industrial park energy systems are verified by examples. It can provide key quantitative indicators and suggestions for the development of green industrial park energy projects.

articleTitle: A Data Clustering and Machine Learning Based Approach to Measuring Urban Carbon Emissions
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Measuring urban carbon emissions accurately and practically is of great significance for the construction of low-carbon cities. However, the current methods for carbon emissions calculation have difficulty in balancing accuracy and practicality. In this paper, a method for measuring urban carbon emissions is proposed. This method determines the pilot user set for urban carbon emissions calculation through clustering algorithm, and explores the mapping relationship between pilot users' operation information data and carbon emissions using a multilayer perceptron model based on artificial neural networks (ANN), and then extends the mapping mechanism to other users. Simulation results show that this method can achieve the calculation of urban carbon emissions with good accuracy and practicality.

articleTitle: Cyber-Attack Risk Assessment and Prevention Strategy of Substations Based on Dynamic Attack and Defense Game
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the improvement of the informatization of the power system, the risk of cyber attack is also increasing. This paper proposes a risk assessment and prevention strategy for cyber attack against substations. Firstly, the cyber attack against substations are modeled based on the game theory of dynamic attack and defense. Secondly, an improved OPA (ORNL-PSERC-Alaska) model is utilized to analyze the cascade failure after cyber attacks and quantify the load loss of power system. Finally, a preventive strategy which can mitigate the expectation load loss caused by cyber attack against substations is put forward. Simulation experiments were conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Charging Optimization of Fast Charging Station Based on Operation Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In the construction of new type power system, in order to reduce the demand pressure on the city's power distribution capacity and promote the application of pure electric buses, this paper proposed the methods to optimize the charging time, charging duration and charging power of pure electric bus in combination with the vehicle operation and charging load characteristics. The mathematical model of charging load optimization and economic operation of fast charging station is established, and the optimization model is solved by particle swarm optimization and hierarchical sequence method. Through the simulation analysis of the cases, the optimization effect of the charging power combined with charging time is the best, which can effectively reduce the distribution capacity of the fast charging station and reduce the charging electricity cost.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Assessment of Photovoltaic Hosting Capacity in Distribution Network via Sparse Polynomial Chaos Expansion
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Assessment of photovoltaic hosting capacity (PVHC) in distribution network (DN) can effectively avoid a series of operation risks (e.g., overvoltage) caused by large-scale integration of distributed photovoltaic (DPV). Considering the uncertainty of DPV output power, the deterministic assessment method may be too conservative and can not give a probability index. With this regard, this paper proposes a probabilistic assessment method of PVHC in DN based on sparse polynomial chaos expansion (SPCE). Firstly, the uncertainty and correlation of DPV are embedded into the model so that a probabilistic assessment model of PVHC is established. Then, the SPCE-based surrogate model is built to further improve the computational efficiency of three-phase probabilistic power flow calculation. The probabilistic overvoltage risk (POR) as an assessment index is also defined. Finally, the simulations on the IEEE 123-bus DN verify the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Game Analysis of Electricity Market Considering Carbon Emission and Green Certificate Trading
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: To achieve the low-carbon transition of power systems, carbon emission trading (CET) and green certificate trading (GCT) mechanisms are being widely used. In order to investigate the effects of these trading mechanisms on electricity market, a Cournot equilibrium model of the day-ahead (DA) electricity market with joint participation of renewable and conventional power generators in CET and GCT is established. In this model, apart from the DA electricity market, conventional power generators participate in CET and GCT, renewable generators participate in GCT. A deviation penalty mechanism is introduced to tackle renewable generators' bid deviations in the DA electricity market caused by uncertainties in their actual power outputs. The nonlinear complementarity approach is employed to solve the equilibrium model. Finally, numerical examples are presented to validate the reasonableness and effectiveness of the proposed model. It is shown that the introduction of CET and GCT can help improve the competitiveness of renewable generators in electricity markets, and reduce carbon emissions of power system.

articleTitle: A Relay Protection Measurement Platform Based on Modularization and Logic Diagram
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to improve the research and development efficiency of relay protection devices, simplify project processes, and enhance the customization and reusability of functions, this paper proposes a relay protection platform based on logic diagram visualization programming and configuration. It can not only encapsulate typical protection and measurement functions into graphical logic modules, but also draw the logic modules into complete logic diagrams. The relay protection and measurement devices developed based on this platform have better reliability, maintainability, flexibility, and reusability. This platform can support logic module unit testing and parallel development of logic modules and diagrams. This development method can greatly improve research and development efficiency, shorten development cycles, reduce operation and maintenance costs, and enhance engineering flexibility.

articleTitle: Modeling and Oscillation Mechanism Analysis of Renewable Energy Base Connected into MMC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the massive access of renewable energy and power electronic devices, interactions between source side and grid side may lead to unstable sub-/super-synchronous oscillation, a kind of new-type power system stability problem. Within this paper, a standard electromagnetic transient simulation case of sub-/super-synchronous oscillation is established, which is consisted of permanent magnet synchronous generators (PMSGs) in a renewable energy base, MMC-HVDC and a weak AC grid. The analysis is conducted using simulation results by impedance modelling methods. A three-port equivalent impedance model is established from the simulation results, and Nyquist stability criterion for two-port network is proved applicable. The Bode diagram and Nyquist diagram are presented to evaluate unstable oscillation risks in the system, and diagrams show that the unstable sub-/super-synchronous oscillation is mainly brought about by complex dynamic interactions of renewable energy base and MMC-HVDC connected into weak AC grid.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Transient Equivalent Model of Power Electronic Switch Based on Physical Intuition
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: At present, the permeability of power electronic devices in the power grid is increasing dramatically. To address the problems of time-varying admittance matrix of power electronic switch binary resistance model, low accuracy and high virtual power loss of associated discrete circuit (ADC) model in transient process, a constant admittance equivalent model based on physical intuition integrated integral exponential is proposed in this paper. In this model, the virtual resistance -RL is introduced into the conduction branch of the ADC constant admittance model to generate power to compensate for the virtual power loss caused by dynamic components. The analytical solution of the proposed equivalent branch was rationalized and simplified to construct the difference equation with exponential form, while the admittance matrix could be guaranteed to be invariant, thus improving the simulation efficiency. Besides, the cross-initialization method is adopted to further reduce the initial error of state switching. Based on the two-level voltage source converter (VSC) circuit, the optimal recommended parameters of the model are given by solving the spectral radius and analyzing virtual power loss of the proposed model. Simulation results confirmed that the proposed model has the advantages of low virtual power loss, high precision, high simulation efficiency, and no numerical oscillation problem.

articleTitle: Research on Stepwise Clustering and Fitting Method for Wind Power Based on Discrete Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The participation of new energy reseurces in market trading needs accurate metering of new energy power generation. In order to establish a verification method for wind power generation metering data, a step-by-5tep k-means clustering algorithm based on discrete wavelet transform is proposed to explore the variation laws of wind power fluctuation, so that a basis for missing data fitting and abnormal data correction of wind power generation curves can be built. The frequency domain analysis of wind power generation data is carried out by using discrete wavelet transform, and the generation curve is decomposed into different frequency ranges. For the frequency domain results after multiple wavelets transforms, step-by-tep k-means clustering is carried out from the lowest frequency component to the highest frequency component. This processing method can etfetively ensure that the information of stroke fluctuation is not lost in the clustering process. Typical curves extracted based on clustering are used to fit the missing data. The proposed method is simulated by using the wind power generation data of some wind farms in East China, and the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: Selection and Development of Oil-immersed Reactive Power Compensation Reactor for High Altitude UHV AC Project
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the construction of UHV AC power transmission projects, some UHV AC substations will be located in high-altitude areas in where the special natural conditions such as ultraviolet and large temperature difference will have a significant impact on the dry reactive power compensation reactor. Developing an oil-immersed reactive power compensation reactor can effectively reduce the impact of natural environment on equipment and improve the reliability. The equipment selection and technical specification of single-phase and three-phase oil immersed reactive power compensation reactor are studied, as well as the simulation calculation of electric field, magnetic field, temperature field, mechanical stress and noise to verify the feasibility of equipment manufacturing and operation. The calculation results show that the performance of the oil-immersed reactive power compensation reactor can meet the operational requirements in high-altitude areas. Finally, through technical and economic comparison, it is recommended to use the 110kV 80MVar single-phase oil-immersed compensation reactor for UHV AC substations in high-altitude areas.

articleTitle: A Model Compression Method for Power Edge Intelligent Inspection via Channel Pruning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In the context of the digital transformation of power equipment in modern power systems, power intelligent inspection is of paramount importance for real-time analysis and diagnostics of power equipment status. However, the constrained computational power and limited memory capacity of edge devices impose limitations on the parameter size and computational demands of object detection algorithms. To overcome this challenge, this study proposes a model compression method for power edge intelligent inspection via channel pruning. Initially, considering the trade-off between speed and accuracy, the YOLOv5 object detection algorithm is chosen as the baseline algorithm. Subsequently, to compress the model size, the ResRep pruning method is employed to compress the YOLOv5 model, and the advantages of ResRep over the conventional BN-λ pruning method are elaborately discussed.
