Finally, comprehensive experiments are conducted on a dataset comprising transmission line defects including insulator defect, pin missing, and nest. Experimental results demonstrate that the ResRep pruning method can reduce the parameter size of YOLOv5 by 2/3 and decrease computational requirements by 1/3, while only sacrificing a marginal 0.9% of accuracy. Moreover, compared to the BN-λ pruning method, ResRep achieves 0.9% higher accuracy at comparable compression ratios.

articleTitle: SSA-TCN-SVM based Short Wind Power Forecast Oriented to Dual Carbon Target
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Seeking green and low-carbon development has become a common consensus of the international community, and wind energy is one of the best new energy sources for the development of low-carbon economy. However, wind power has strong randomness and volatility, which will bring new challenges to the green and low-carbon operation of new power systems. Relying on the new power system, accurate power prediction of wind turbines can not only optimize the power supply structure of the power system, but also promote energy conservation, emission reduction and ‘low-carbon’ development of the power industry. Therefore, under the above background, this paper proposes a short-term wind power prediction model based on Singular Spectrum Analysis-Temporal Convolutional Network-Support Vector Machine (SSA-TCN-SVM). Aiming at the problem that the Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) prediction model still has complex modes and the Dense Layer cannot set the weights reasonably, a cascade model based on Temporal Convolutional Network-Support Vector Machine (TCN-SVM) is adopted. The kernel function of Support Vector Machine (SVM) is used to map the vectors output by the convolution kernel channel of each time to the high-dimensional kernel space. The optimal weights are obtained by solving the dual problem, and the prediction ability of the single grouping sequence prediction model is improved. By minimizing the prediction error of the grouping sequence, the prediction accuracy of the whole prediction model is improved. Experiments show that SSA-TCN-SVM has better prediction performance.

articleTitle: Novel Partial Discharge Pattern Recognition Method Based on Deep Learning and SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Partial discharge (PD) is a critical issues in the high-voltage power systems. In the study, we raise a novel PD pattern recognition method based on both deep learning and Support Vector Machine (SVM). This method include a deep learning model to PD signals, capturing complex patterns and variations. These features are then inputted into an SVM classifier for precise classification and recognition of different types of PD. Its potential applications include condition monitoring, fault diagnosis, and predictive maintenance of power equipment. Further research can explore enhancements and optimizations of this method to achieve better performance and broader application.

articleTitle: A Novel Low-Carbon Regulation Method for Power Systems Based on Electric-Carbon Coordination
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The novel power system environment is dominated by new energy sources, and the random, intermittent and fluctuating nature of new energy generation brings impact on the safe and stable operation of the power grid, and all aspects of power grid dispatching will change significantly. In order to fully exploit the synergistic regulation potential of each scheduling interaction of wind, hydro, thermal and storage, this paper constructs a multi-objective intelligent regulation architecture for power grids in the novel power system environment, and integrates regulation of power grids from the perspective of economy and low carbon, and builds an index evaluation system for low carbon operation of power grids from the generation side, grid side and load side. The simulation results of the Zhejiang provincial grid show that the proposed method can realize the low carbon and economic operation of the grid.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on GIS Partial Discharge Location Based on EMTR-DBSCAN
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Accurately detecting and locating partial discharge (PD) in gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) is critical for identifying insulation defects and improving maintenance efficiency. Recently, electromagnetic time reversal (TR) technology has emerged as an effective location method for PD. The TR process typically involves three steps: (1) recording the PD propagation signal via a sensor, (2) time reversal, and injecting the signal back into the medium, and (3) using appropriate criteria to determine the focal point corresponding to the location of the PD source. However, determining the focal time in current TR location can be challenging. To address this problem, we propose a PD location method based on TR-DBSCAN and verify its effectiveness in locating PD sources in GIS using CST simulation. We use the DBSCAN clustering algorithm to locate PD sources based on the difference between the waveforms at the signal source and non-signal source positions. This approach solves the issue of determining the focal time in three-dimensional space. The results demonstrate that our proposed method achieves precise location of PD sources in GIS with significant improvements in location accuracy.

articleTitle: ConvTasNet Based Transformer Sound Noise Reduction and Condition Recognition Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a transformer audio noise reduction and condition recognition network based on ConvTasNet to improve the recognition accuracy of transformer sound patterns in the presence of environmental noise. The network employs ConvTasNet for audio noise reduction and a convolutional neural network for transformer condition recognition. A dataset of audio data under different operating conditions of the transformer is prepared through simulation experiments. The noise reduction and condition recognition network is compared with other noise reduction methods in terms of noise reduction effect and recognition accuracy improvement. Results demonstrate that the noise reduction and condition recognition network outperforms other noise reduction methods, achieving a 9.84 dB improvement in SISNR of the audio and 25.85% improvement in recognition accuracy. In field applications, the proposed network effectively improves the recognition accuracy of transformer acoustic patterns.

articleTitle: Research on Wind Turbine Heating System Combined with Solar Heating System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Wind turbine heating system and solar heating system use the complementarity of renewable wind and solar energy, can improve the heating rate of the heating system to the greatest extent. A novel model of wind turbine heating system combines wind energy and heat pump. It uses wind energy to directly drive the heat pump compressor, without power generation segment. Wind turbine heating system has high energy utilization rate, and can maintain stable heat storage by adding latent thermal energy storage segment at the end of the wind turbine. Solar energy as clean renewable energy, its rational application can promote our country to achieve carbon neutrality and carbon peak. However, its performance is indirect due to weather conditions. Latent thermal energy storage can effectively solve the contradiction of intermittent solar thermal supply and demand mismatch, and improve energy utilization efficiency. This paper proposes a new heating system with wind turbine heating system as the main unit, solar heating system as a supplement, which combines with latent thermal energy storage device. The surplus heat is stored during low load periods, and such energy is used to supply heat during high load periods, which is a way of peak load shifting.

articleTitle: Research on Hierarchical Control Method of Micro Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In the micro integrated energy system, when the load changes, how to manage power output of equipment of the integrated energy system to meet the requirement of customers is a current problem. Based on it, the operation of micro-integrated energy systems is studied and the hierarchical optimization control method is designed which is composed of coordination control layer and optimization control layer. According to the characteristics of different time scales of the integrated energy subsystem, the optimization control layer is divided into three sub layers: slow layer, medium layer and fast layer. Using the hierarchical optimization strategy, the power of main equipment is dynamically adjusted according to the time scale, and the gas-fired boiler can smoothly transit to a stable state through soft switching during the change of heat load. The research result shows that through the control of the system, the coordinated control of the output power of the main equipment in the integrated energy system is realized, and therefore the power quality problems caused by the instability of renewable energy generation and load fluctuation in the micro integrated energy system are effectively solved, and the multi energy collaborative supply is also realized.

articleTitle: A Low-Rank Algorithm Based on Riemannian Optimization for Optimal Power Flow Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The optimal power flow (OPF) problem is essentially a mathematical programming that aims to seek an optimal operation condition subject to network and physical constraints. The semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxation has emerged as a popular technique to solve the OPF problem, but it often finds a high-rank solution and encounters difficulties in obtaining an exact solution for mesh network. Therefore, this paper utilizes a Riemannian optimization method to solve the low-rank optimal solution for OPF problem via SDP. Firstly, a Burer-Monteiro factorization-based augmented Lagrangian method is applied to the standard SDP of OPF. Then, the Riemannian gradient and Hessian are derived to solve the subproblem with the Riemannian trust-region method. Finally, the strategy for escaping from saddle points and the technique that adjusts the parameters for solving a low-rank solution are given. The simulation results verify the accuracy of the proposed algorithm can obtain a lower-rank solution compared to other advanced SDP solvers.

articleTitle: A Framework for Anomaly Detection with Integrated Power System Operation Data
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the increasing complexity of power distribution networks and increasing flexibility of components' interconnections, control centers often have difficulty obtaining a complete and accurate system operation states in real time. The problems are accredited to anomalies, such as data communication errors and weather factors. Anomalies can affect both the cyber and physical layers of a system, and thus degrade the state estimation (SE) performance. To date, there is no comprehensive method that can handle all anomalies, and each method corresponds to a specific scenario. Therefore, this paper first made a general discussion of the existing anomaly detection deficiencies. Then, a generic framework is presented for achieving adequate static and dynamic anomaly detections. Finally, testing of basic algorithms proposed in the anomaly detection framework is tested.

articleTitle: Research on the Energy Measurement System and Traceability of Charging Stations Based on High Real-Time Network Management
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a high-precision and real-time network management electric vehicle charging station energy metering and billing system, aiming to solve the real-time measurement and transaction settlement problems of electric vehicle single charging energy. The system includes a layered distributed network system, a three-level billing wireless transmission system, a modular energy billing management system, and a charging station circuit design. At the same time, experimental testing and analysis were conducted on the impact of environmental temperature and humidity, electrical fast transient pulse group immunity, radio frequency electromagnetic field immunity, and radio frequency field induced conduction immunity on the system's electrical energy metering data. The results indicate that the impact of the energy metering system for charging stations based on network management on the accuracy of measurement data does not exceed ± 0.2%.

articleTitle: Light-Weight Object Detector for Power Intelligent Inspection via Re-parameterization
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Electric power edge intelligent inspection, which conducts power intelligent detection on edge devices, can alleviate the issues of high computational load and lengthy data transmission time in traditional cloud computing mode. However, the low computational power of edge devices results in slow inference speeds for detection algorithms at the edge, and their limited memory constrains the spatial occupancy of the object detection models. Addressing these challenges, this paper proposes a power transmission line defect edge intelligent detection method via improved YOLOv5. First, R-D block is introduced in this paper, which combines RepVGG and diverse branch block (DBB) to enhance the backbone and neck networks of YOLOv5 and expedite the model's inference speed through re-parameterization. Subsequently, re-parameterized spatial pyramid pooling (RepSPP) is proposed to fuse multi-scale features and improve the accuracy of YOLOv5 through the integration of large kernel convolution and depth-wise (DW) convolution. Finally, extensive experiments are carried out on a power transmission line defect dataset, which includes pin missing, insulator defect, and nest. The experimental results demonstrate that, compared to the original YOLOv5, the proposed method enhances the inference speed by a factor of 1.8 and improves the accuracy by 3.6%, significantly enhancing the efficiency of power transmission line edge intelligent inspection.

articleTitle: Feasible Region Analysis of Penetration Level of PV in Active Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the promotion of new energy power system in China, large-scale connection of distributed photovoltaic (PV) has brought uncertain risks to the distribution network. Energy storage (ES) can support a high penetration rate of renewable energy integrated into the distribution network due to its flexible control characteristics. In this paper, the proposed method based on the multi-parameter programming method can visualize the feasible region boundary of PV access capacity with full consideration of the coupling effects among different access nodes. Firstly, the typical scenarios of PV are obtained by clustering. Then, a method is proposed to describe the feasible region considering the operation constraints of distribution network and ES operation constraints, which takes the PV access capacity of different nodes as the planning parameter. Finally, the effectiveness of the feasible region acquisition method is verified through the simulation of IEEE-33 bus system, and the influence of ES on the feasible region of PV capacity is analyzed.

articleTitle: A Distribution Network Loss Reduction Strategy Based on Seamless Closed-Loop Load Transfer Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Seamless closed-loop load transfer devices(SLTD) itself is used to ensure power supply, but it actually has potential applications in reducing network loss by appropriately transferring load. Aiming at distribution network loss attributable to the mismatching between the output of distributed new energy power supply and the electricity demand of load, a distribution network loss reduction strategy based on SLTD is proposed in this paper. Initially, the loss reduction mechanism is explained and a mathematical model is built. Secondly, a method for optimizing target preprocessing is proposed to reduce the dimensionality of the target data, after which sparrow search algorithm(SSA) is adopted for solution seeking. Finally, a regional distribution network in an urban of China is used as an example to demonstrate the availability of the proposed strategy. Moreover, this strategy shows the potential value of the current stock assets of distribution network.

articleTitle: Study of Sensorless Control of IPMSM Based on Model Reference Adaptive Control with Improved Adaptive Law
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: According to the Popov criterion, this paper analyzes and proves that the speed identification using the commonly used model reference adaptive control method with the identity matrix linear compensator for the interior permanent magnet synchronous motor has a particular defect; namely, it can only achieve speed identification within a specific speed range: the estimated speed diverges from the actual one when the given speed of rotor reach a higher level. In this paper, a new speed adaptive law is derived to enable model reference adaptive control to work effectively in the entire speed range with a newly designed linear compensator. At the same time, the identification stability of this method is proved through the Popov criterion. Finally, the simulation verifies this new adaptive law, and the results show that this method can achieve accurate identification of rotor speed and position with excellent performance.

articleTitle: Active Disturbance Rejection Control Based on Fuzzy Hybrid Extended State Observer for Speed Loop of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The anti-disturbance performance is an important index of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) in operation, and the load torque mutation in the motor speed loop will make the motor run unsteadily. Linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) for motor speed loops can deal with the disturbance well. On this basis, an improved extended state observer (IESO) is introduced, which can improve the observation speed of disturbance and reduce the observation pressure of the observer. In order to obtain the advantages of both the traditional extended state observer and the improved extended state observer a hybrid control strategy based on fuzzy control is designed. Finally, the designed control strategy is compared and analyzed by simulation to verify its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Study On Active Voltage Arc Suppression Scheme For Single Cascade Series Type Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In view of the drawbacks of the parallel-type active arc suppression device in distribution network, such as redundant structure, complex control and high cost, we propose an active arc suppression method for distribution network faults based on series voltage division. The H-bridge converter and arc extinguishing coil series voltage division operation method can clearly reduce the voltage bearing value of power electronic inverter, and has good performance in arc extinguishing principle and control, equipment voltage bearing and safety, power output and overvoltage protection. Since the traditional PI control strategy has the problems of not being able to catch the AC signal without static difference and poor anti-interference performance, the predictive control strategy is introduced to design the control system, which can realize the catching of AC signal without static deviation without parameter adjustment and can effectively compensate the grounding residual current. Finally, the effectiveness of proposed arc suppression scheme is confirmed by emulation experiments, which provides theoretical basis for optimizing active arc suppression and grounding protection.

articleTitle: Research Progress in Cold Start and Control Strategies of Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The use of hydrogen energy has got wide attention under the “dual carbon” goal, and improving the cold startup performance and dynamic stability of proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) using hydrogen as raw material is of great significance for the fuel cell industry and chemical industry. In extremely cold environments, the interior of the battery may freeze and block pores, obstructing the flow of chemically reactive gases and making it difficult to start the battery cold; Since PEMFC is a complex strong coupling nonlinear system, the output power stability fluctuation and output voltage uniformity deterioration will occur after the startup. In this paper, the research progress of proton exchange membrane fuel cells in recent years is reviewed from three cold start strategies, and the control strategies of the start-up cells are summarized. It also proposes a prospect for the development of PEMFC at low temperatures: a single cold start strategy and control strategy have their own advantages and disadvantages. Research on PEMFC should focus on collaborative control in multiple ways to ensure that the battery stack is not excessively damaged and adapt to extremely cold environment conditions.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Lightning Performance of 6kV Distribution Line
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to improve the lightning performance of the 6kV distribution line, the design needs to combine the characteristics of lightning activities of the area where the distribution line is located to carry out the simulation calculation analysis of the lightning performance of 6kV distribution line, the lightning trip-out model constructed by integrating the lightning ground density distribution along the line and line tower design parameters, etc. This paper combines the ground flash monitoring data from 2012 to 2021 of the lightning positioning system in the area where a 6kV distribution line is located, conducts lightning parameter statistics for the 6kV line corridor, simulates and studies the lightning performance under different design conditions, obtains the lightning performance characteristics and key influencing factors of the 6kV distribution line, and integrates the optimal design method to improve the lightning withstand level and limit the lightning trip-out rate of the 6kV distribution line.

articleTitle: Analysis of Distribution Network Reliability Factors Based on AHP-Improved Entropy Weight Method and Gray Correlation Degree
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to deal with the difficulties of similar weights of various reliability influencing factors in the distribution system and comprehensively assess the weight values of different influencing factors in the distribution network, a combination of the improved entropy weight algorithm and the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) was incorporated into the grey correlation analysis algorithm. This integration allows for a holistic evaluation of subjective and objective perspectives on these factors, in order to improve the objectivity of its evaluation. Firstly, a hybrid approach integrating the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and the EntropyWeight Method was implemented to adjust multiple power supply reliability indicators. This modification aimed to establish comprehensive evaluation indicators for assessing power supply reliability. Secondly, use comprehensive evaluation indicators to conduct grey correlation analysis on the influencing factors of power supply reliability, calculate the final correlation degree of each influencing factor, and rank them. Finally, four power supply areas were validated, and the results showed that this method can effectively identify the factors that have a significant impact on power supply reliability. And it can provide the basis for the distribution network power supply reliability enhancement preferences, so that the distribution system to make timely targeted measures to greatly improve the efficiency of reliability enhancement.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Testing Method for Energy-Saving Hydraulic Motors
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Most of the hydraulic motor testing systems in present engineering application employ frequency hydraulic oil pumps to provide the required pressure and flow for testing. For different models of hydraulic motors, it may lead to increased closed-loop or open-loop control time or failure of testing, resulting in resource waste. This paper uses PLC to drive the inverter to intelligently control the variable frequency hydraulic oil pumps. This method enables the testing system to provide the optimal pressure or flow required for the experiment, which reduces the electric energy waste caused by constant power output of frequency hydraulic oil pumps with fixed pressure and fixed flow. The electronic control part of the motor testing system applies integrated circuit technology and modular control circuit design, which improves the stability and anti-interference ability of the control system. Efficiency tests on the MRH-190 hydraulic motors are conducted and compared with the results using traditional testing systems. The electric energy consumption is significantly reduced under the same operating conditions, which proves the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Frequency Control Strategy Considering Dynamic Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the continuous increase in wind power penetration, the participation of large-scale wind power in frequency regulation has become crucial for the development of wind energy. Power allocation methods need to be more intelligent and simplified. Direct frequency regulation at the unit level can result in frequency measurement errors and poor coordination performance. To address this issue, a frequency control strategy for wind farms considering dynamic classification is designed. Specifically, the following steps are taken: Firstly, a classification method for dynamic classification of doubly fed induction generator (DFIGs) is designed based on the trend of wind speed variation. Then, the wind farm performs power allocation to the DFIGs. At the upper level, an active power allocation algorithm is developed based on the results of dynamic classification, determining the active power outputs of different categorized units. At the lower level, a proportional allocation algorithm is employed to distribute the power allocated by the upper level to each DFIG. Finally, overspeed and pitch control are applied to regulate the DFIGs. A simulation model of a DFIG-based grid integration system with different wind speeds is constructed in MATLAB/SIMULINK. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively reduces the active power output of DFIGs during frequency rise, thereby improving the frequency at the grid connection point.

articleTitle: DC Voltage Regulation Bandwidth Enhancement Control in VSG based Bi-directional EV Charger
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: VSG-based bi-directional piles currently use DC/DC to regulate the intermediate DC bus voltage, and a gridside converter (VSG) to realize the charging and discharging power. However, there are steady-state deviations in the power under grid frequency perturbations, which cannot accurately track the commanded values. Thus, this paper proposes a new VSG bidirectional pile control architecture, i.e., a converter (VSG) is used to control the intermediate DC bus voltage, while DC/DC is used to accurately track the charging and discharging power. However, the VSG, as the inner loop of the DC voltage control outer loop, has an extremely slow dynamic response and cannot achieve voltage stabilization. At the same time, the conventional VSG has the problem that it is difficult to achieve fast power following and provide high inertia support at the same time, which limits the application of virtual synchronous machine in bidirectional charging pile to some extent. To this end, this paper further proposes to significantly increase the bandwidth of the VSG power loop by introducing feedforward channels and filters to eliminate the inherent oscillation poles of the VSG, thus significantly reducing the inner loop delay of the outer loop of the DC voltage, while achieving closed-loop regulation of the DC voltage.

articleTitle: GIS Partial Discharge Inversion Method Based on Digital Simulation and Virtual Extended Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: To address the problem of internal state inversion of power equipment under the digital twin model, a partial discharge (PD) localization method based on GIS digital simulation is proposed in the paper. Firstly, a batch simulation is performed to obtain the discharge fault database. Then, the adaptive fuzzy inference system method is used to virtually extend the sensor to extend the amount of local discharge information provided by the UHF signal parametric to some extent. Finally, the simulated database is used as the training set of the neural network algorithm to generate the discharge inversion localization network, and the spatial location of the discharge is obtained as the output of the network. The simulation test verifies the accuracy of the proposed method for PD localization. The subsequent work will be based on the measured data to deduce the real discharge location within the GIS.

articleTitle: TOPSIS-based Comprehensive Assessment Method of Short-term PV Power Prediction Errors
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: For the safe and economic operation of new power system comprising large-scale PV power generation, a highly accurate short-term photovoltaic (PV) power forecast is of significance. Currently, traditional statistical indicators are utilized to evaluate the prediction results, and it lacks a more reasonable comprehensive evaluation system to assess the merits and demerits of the selected prediction model and system. Consequently, this paper firstly proposes a series of comprehensive evaluation index system that includes common error evaluation indexes, forecast assessment indexes, and volatility indexes, considering the forecast assessment indexes of prediction results and the impact of cloud motions on PV power in PV sites. Then, a thorough evaluation approach based on technology for order preference by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS) for PV power prediction (PVPP) errors is developed. Finally, based on actual data from a PV power plant, various prediction methods and evaluation indexes are assessed comprehensively, which confirm the feasibility of the proposed evaluation approach of PVPP errors.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Power Quality Based on CRTIC Entropy Weight Unascertained Measure Considering Spatiotemporal Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The large-scale integration of distributed photovoltaic systems into transformer areas brings various power quality issues, requiring a scientific and comprehensive evaluation method. In order to comprehensively evaluate the power quality indicators of multiple time and location dimensions for multi station power quality, this paper proposes a CRTIC entropy weight unascertained measure power quality comprehensive evaluation method that takes into account spatiotemporal characteristics. Considering the uncertainty of the spatiotemporal characteristics of power quality indicators, a power quality evaluation system is constructed from the spatiotemporal dimension based on current indicators. Obtain the scoring matrix for different time and nodes within the station area through the CRITIC unascertained measurement model. To further evaluate the power quality of transformer sections, the TOPSIS model improved by grey correlation degree was used to obtain the power quality scores of different transformer sections in terms of time and space dimensions, as well as the comprehensive scores of transformer section power quality. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method were verified through practical example analysis.

articleTitle: Stochastic Game based Microgrid Clusters Energy Management Modeling and Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The advanced energy management model and strategy is a powerful guarantee the economic benefit of microgrid (MG) system. In this paper, a perfect microgrid cluster model with two agents, which enables the energy management and trading, is constructed based on stochastic game theory. In order to solve this game problem, an improved deep Q network (DQN), which adopts upper confidence bound (UCB) to implicitly balance exploration and exploitation and the modified Q-value calculation, is proposed to leverages the novel exploration of state to accelerate convergence and achieve the optimal energy management strategy. Simulation results indicate that our proposed game model with constant and dynamic pricing has advantages in different microgrid operation situations.

articleTitle: Cryptocurrency Mining Detection Based on Time Series Clustering of Electricity Consumption Volume
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: A method with community detection in electricity consumption volume was developed to recognize suspected cryptocurrency miners from power-intensive users in China in authors' previous work. However, the detection result is parameter-sensitive and highly relies on selection of distance threshold value. The sensitivity can be resulted from either the clustering method or the distance metric. It has been found that the mining activity in China is featured with strong seasonality and can be detected with clustering-based methods. On this basis, in this paper, different clustering methods as well as different distance metrics are investigated for less parameter-dependence. As for clustering method, community detection, K-means clustering and hierarchical clustering are investigated. As for distance metrics, Pearson correlation-based distance, Euclidean distance and dynamic time warping (DTW) distance are investigated. The candidate method combinations are tested in Sichuan and Xinjiang cases and the detection effect as well as parameter dependency is compared. It is found that hierarchical clustering with DTW distance metric can generate accurate and stable results without parameter selection. The method can be applied for cryptocurrency detection in more general situations.

articleTitle: A Low Carbon Dispatching Method for Equivalence Grids Considering Cross-Regional Carbon Emission Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an approach to achieve environmentally sustainable grid operation through an equivalence grid low-carbon dispatching method that considers cross-regional carbon sensitivity. Firstly, the paper conducts carbon emission tracking for the overall grid. Secondly, the paper analyzes the external grid interaction boundary and equivalence method of the regional grid under study and calculates the power and carbon emission exchange mechanism between the regional grid and the external grid. Subsequently, the paper constructs a low-carbon dispatching method considering sensitivity based on the power and carbon emission characteristics of the internal and external power sources of the regional grid. The paper optimizes the power output adjustment priority of each power source based on the carbon emission contribution of internal and external power sources to the internal load of the regional power grid and the regulation sensitivity. Finally, the paper realizes the optimal carbon emission dispatching strategy of the regional power grid.

articleTitle: Intelligent Alarm Method of Ultra-Supercritical Units Based on Kernel Density Estimation and Convolutional Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to improve the performance and operational safety of ultra-supercritical (USC) units alarm system, the problem of unreasonable setting of the traditional alarm threshold is addressed. In this paper, an alarm threshold optimization method based on kernel density estimation (KDE) and convolutional optimization algorithm (COA) is proposed. Firstly, the KDE method is used to estimate the data in normal and abnormal states. Secondly, in view of the traditional method that only considers missed alarms and false alarms, this paper introduces the detection delay expectation, and comprehensively considers the above three evaluation indicators to establish the objective function of optimizing the alarm threshold. Then, the COA is used to solve the objective function optimally. Finally, the simulation results show that the method ensures low false alarms while greatly reducing missed alarms and detection delay expectation, which enhances the alarm system performance.

articleTitle: Automatic Generation Control Strategy with Aggregated Generation Units Based on Mesh Adaptive Multi-Objective Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: To enable renewable energy sources (RES) to better and more efficiently assist traditional generators in attending the automatic generation control (AGC), firstly, renewable energy power plants and energy storage systems (ESSs) are formed as the aggregated generation unit (AGU). Secondly, a real-time mesh adaptive multi-objective optimization algorithm (MA-MO) calculation is proposed. The proposed algorithm combines the real-time simulation and MA-MO results based on the future load disturbance prediction data. Then the optimal allocation ratio of AGC instructions is calculated for the 1-minute-ahead operation of the traditional generator and AGU, improving the AGC performance with the minimum system frequency deviation and smoothing the state of charge (SoC) of ESS. Finally, the proposed optimization algorithm is verified based on the simulation of a field AGU system.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of Transformer on the Reactive Power Output Capability of Condenser
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The condenser connected to the power grid (PG) through the transformer will consume some reactive power (RP) on the transformer, which will make the estimation of the reactive power support capacity (RPSC) on the high-voltage side incorrect. Incorrect estimation will lead to insufficient RP support of the condenser in case of failure and affect system stability. Therefore, this paper studies the influence of transformer on the reactive power output (RPO) capability of the condenser. Firstly, the expression of the peak value (PV) of RPO on the high voltage side (HVS) of the condenser during the fault is derived. Then, according to the expression, the parameter conditions for the maximum reactive PV and the extreme value of RPSC at the HVS are analyzed. Finally, the magnitude of RP consumed on the transformer is analyzed, and the difference between the RPO capacity of the condenser and the extreme value of the RPSC at the HVS of the transformer is compared.

articleTitle: Research on the Peak-Valley Time-of-Use Electricity Price Mechanism for Power System Flexibility Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Renewable energy has the characteristics of randomness and intermittency. When the proportion of renewable energy on the system power supply side gradually increases, the fluctuation and uncertainty of the system power supply side will be greatly increased. At the same time, in the new power system, a large number of distributed power sources are connected to the load side, resulting in fluctuations on the load side, which leads to double uncertainty of source and load, and the lack of flexibility of the power system is highlighted. Based on the analysis of long-time flexibility needs of Shanghai power grid, this paper fully mobilizes the enthusiasm of various market players for improving the flexibility of the power system through market means. In the long-time scale, the mechanism of TOU electricity price is introduced to adjust the electricity consumption on the load side. By setting different peak-valley electricity price spread, the electricity consumption changes in the process of gradually increasing peak-valley electricity price differentials are studied.

articleTitle: Establishment of a Four Probe Method for Measuring Surface Resistance of Materials
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Surface resistance is an important electrical property of materials, which can characterize the doping of materials, indirectly calculate the carrier mobility of semiconductor materials, and then affect the operating frequency of devices. Accurate measurement of surface resistance is an important link in the process of material production, which is directly related to the quality of material production. Four probe measurement method is the most frequently used measurement method. Although this method is not the most advanced, it is widely used because of its simple and mature. The maximum current of four probe measuring devices on the market is usually 100 mA which can not meet the requirement of measuring the surface resistance of low resistance materials. In this paper, the external current source is used to expand the current range to 3A, and the automatic test software is developed based on Lab VIEW platform, which can meet the surface resistance test of low resistance materials and solve the problem of small current range of traditional measuring equipment.

articleTitle: Electrothermal Decoupling Method for Aluminum Electrolyzer Considering Heat Supply from CHP Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Considering that the aluminum electrolytic load, as an important demand response resource, affects the heat balance in the electrolyzer when it participates in the system demand response process, and that the system electric-thermal energy coupling relationship is complex when the cogeneration unit and electrolyzer operate jointly, this paper proposes an electrothermal decoupling method when the CHP unit and electrolyzer operate jointly. Firstly, the aluminum electrolyzer is divided into two systems, solid-liquid, and their heat calculation equations are studied separately. Finally, the mathematical expressions of electrolyte temperature versus time and electrolyte temperature versus CHP unit heat output and electrolyzer current are obtained. The model can well observe the dynamic change process of temperature with time and the relationship between temperature and current and heat output of the CHP unit. Finally, this model is compared with the traditional heat balance constraint model, and the validity and reasonableness of the proposed model are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Online Evaluation Method of Power System Frequency Strength and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The substitution of large-scale renewable energy for traditional synchronous generators reduces the frequency strength of the power system and increases the risk of frequency instability. Currently, online evaluation of system frequency strength and monitoring system frequency stability margin are of great significance to the safe and stable operation of the system. Therefore, this paper proposes an online evaluation method of frequency strength suitable for the actual provincial asynchronous power grid. The system includes three parts: data acquisition and preprocessing, system frequency modulation model simplification and system frequency strength evaluation. Firstly, based on the monitoring operation control system, the operating condition information such as the start-up and output of each equipment in the system is obtained. And through data in BPA and the wide area measurement system, the dynamic model library of equipment frequency modulation in the system can be established. Secondly, the equipment running in the system can be reduced by the method of unified transfer function structure (UTFS) approximation. Furthermore, based on the UTFS parameters of the system, the frequency drop depth coefficient and slope coefficient are calculated to evaluate the frequency strength of the system. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed evaluation method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Adaptive Setting Method for Inverse-time Overcurrent Protection of Active Distribution Network in Complex Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the continuous increase of grid-connected permeability of distributed power supply (DG), the power flow direction and fault current characteristics of active distribution networks have changed essentially compared with a traditional radial distribution network of a single power source. The randomness and uncertainty of distributed power output also make the operation scenarios of the distribution network complex and diverse. It brings significant challenges to the relay protection setting of the distribution network, but also reduces the applicability and reliability of the conventional three-stage protection. This paper first investigates the representative operation scenarios of active distribution networks (ADNs). Based on various DG output probability models, the generation method of representative operation scenarios of ADNs is proposed based on Latin hypercube sampling and the K-Medoids clustering algorithm. Then, an ADN model integrated with multiple types of DGs is used to analyze the impact of DG grid integration on the overcurrent protection of the ADN. Afterwards, an optimization-based method is proposed to generate the inverse-time overcurrent protection setting template for ADNs, and an adaptive multi-population elite strategy based Jaya algorithm is applied as the optimization solver. Based on that, a template library for the overcurrent protection settings under representative operation scenarios of the active distribution network can be constructed. Finally, a cosine similarity based scenario matching method is used to carry out the adaptive setting of the protection values of active distribution networks. The simulation results prove that the proposed method can significantly improve the reliability of ADN protection.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of the Integrated Electricity and Heating System Considering Low-Carbon Policies
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the introduction of China's dual carbon target, the low-carbon energy system transformation faces many risk challenges. The integrated electricity and heating system planning plays a key role in the low-carbon transformation of the energy system. The current research related to the integrated electricity and heating system planning considering the energy policies is not complete in the planning candidate equipment consideration, and many planning studies of the integrated energy system only consider the thermal power balance for the thermal system. The thermal network model in energy systems planning is not accurate enough. For this reason, this paper considers the low-carbon policies as well as the variable flow and the variable temperature strategy of the hydraulic-thermal heating network modeling. An integrated energy system planning model including combined heat and power units, electric boilers, heat storage tanks, transmission lines, and thermal pipelines is established. For the non-convex nonlinear hydraulic-thermal heating network model, the quadratic convex relaxation algorithm is used to transform the planning model into a mixed integer second-order cone programming model. The effectiveness of the proposed method is also verified by the simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization Strategy for Orderly Charging and Discharging of Electric Vehicles in V2G Scenario
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The charging burden on the EV has a detrimental impact on the grid when many EVs are connected to it. To address this issue, we suggest an orderly charge-discharge approach in v2g mode in this article. A multi-purpose optimization model for orderly charging and discharging of EV in v2g mode was built by examining the architecture of V2G technology and the features of EV. We seek to reduce the standard deviation of the system burden and the user's overall charging costs while taking into consideration the characteristics of the random dispersal of electric cars. The model was optimized using a dynamic self-adaptive inertial weight coefficient particle group optimization method under the constraints of charge/discharge duration and charge/discharge load of electric cars. According to the modeling findings, the ordered charge-discharge approach lowers load variance in the grid and serves as a peak cutting and valley filling mechanism.

articleTitle: An Acceleration Method Based on Customized Preprocessing for Capacity Expansion Planning in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: High renewable energy penetration contributes to an increase in seasonal electricity imbalance. Capacity expansion planning (CEP) is essential in alleviating such uncertainty and variability in the power system. However, the network structure and the coupling constraints of different time steps increase the computation complexity of CEP, even for its linear programming formulation. Moreover, the problem could be ill-conditioned, preventing it from being solved efficiently. This paper proposes a customized preprocessing method to handle the numerical difficulties that arise in practical computation. We demonstrate through multiple case studies, from the European case to the Asian case and from one-year CEP to multi-year CEP, that the proposed approach outperforms the direct application of a commercial solver on solving the CEP, significantly reducing the computational time up to 83.3%. Moreover, due to the special structure of the coefficient matrix of the linear program, we also develop a decoupling method based on ADMM and provide the preliminary experiment results.

articleTitle: Power System Reliability Assessment Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the application of big data technology and the improvement of its level, more and more enterprises and organizations begin to use big data analysis and mining technology to support business decisions. Big data technology has found applications in the electric power industry, particularly in predicting and evaluating the reliability of distribution systems. By utilizing big data information from the distribution network, the reliability prediction and evaluation method based on big data technology can possess the capability to pinpoint critical factors that exert a substantial influence on reliability indicators. These factors are then used to establish an efficient prediction model[1]. Among them, the rough set information entropy theory can help determine factors that are highly correlated and independent of each other, thereby improving the accuracy and reliability of predictions. Furthermore, real-time monitoring, fault prediction and diagnosis, fault location, and recovery of distribution systems can be effectively conducted using big data technology. These applications contribute to enhancing the efficiency and stability of power system. To sum up, the application of big data technology provides new ideas and methods for reliability analysis and management of distribution systems, and is expected to provide better solutions for reliability improvement and improvement in the power field.

articleTitle: Study on Estimation Method of Actual Discharge Quantity Inferred from Ultra-High Frequency Signals in Digital Modeling of GIS
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Detection of partial discharge (PD) in gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) is an effective method for state assessment and fault diagnosis. Estimating the actual discharge quantity is an important aspect of PD detection. The commonly used measurement method is the pulse current method, but it is not applicable for online use. To address this issue, this paper proposes a method for estimating the maximum actual discharge quantity based on the second integral value of ultra-high frequency (UHF) signals over time. Firstly, the study establishes a digital model of GIS, including the model of PD sources and ultra-high frequency sensors. The rationality of estimating the actual discharge quantity using the integral value of ultra-high frequency signals over time is verified through simulation data. Finally, by comparing and analyzing the results with high-voltage test data, the factors affecting the accuracy of estimating the actual discharge quantity are identified. The research findings provide a solution for analyzing the intrinsic discharge quantity within GIS based on digital modeling.

articleTitle: Research on the Peer-to-Peer Market Transaction Mechanism of the Future Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Peer-to-peer (P2P) market transaction mechanism is a promising approach to enable decentralized and efficient trading of energy in future energy systems. This paper provides a review of the P2P market transaction mechanism in the context of future energy systems. The review covers the fundamental principles of P2P energy trading, the technical requirements and challenges, the regulatory and policy frameworks, and the potential benefits and drawbacks. We also highlight some of the emerging trends and innovations in P2P energy trading, such as blockchain-based platforms, smart contracts, and artificial intelligence-based optimization. Finally, we identify some of the research gaps and future directions in P2P energy trading, such as the need for standardized protocols, the integration of renewable energy sources and energy storage systems, and the development of equitable and inclusive market structures.

articleTitle: Energy Internet Value Chain, Innovation Chain, and Industrial Chain Fusion Technology Development Strategy Based on SWOT Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Based on SWOT analysis, discuss the development strategy of energy Internet value chain, innovation chain, and industrial chain integration technology. Through the analysis of its advantages, disadvantages, opportunities and threats, three key development strategies are proposed, including enhancing the technical innovation capability of the Energy Internet, promoting the coordinated development of the Energy Internet industry, and strengthening the international cooperation of the Energy Internet, and deriving the mathematical model of the energy change rate. In addition, through the analysis of typical cases, the application of this technology in practice is discussed, and the application prospects in the future are forecasted. From a comprehensive analysis, it can be seen that the energy Internet value chain, innovation chain, and industrial chain integration technology have many advantages, but also have certain disadvantages. Therefore, in the future, it is necessary to further strengthen technological innovation and coordinated development, and promote the deep integration of Energy Internet and other fields, so as to realize a virtuous cycle and sustainable development of energy Internet value chain, innovation chain, and industrial chain integration technology.

Author Keywords: innovation chain and industrial chain fusion technology

articleTitle: Robust Optimal Scheduling of Distribution Networks Considering the Tail Correlation of Power and Load
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Constructing reasonable uncertainty sets is a prerequisite for applying robust optimization in power system scheduling problems. To enhance the precision of the uncertainty set, this paper proposes constructing uncertainty sets based on tail correlation, jointly characterizes the power-load uncertainty in the system, and applies it to the optimization and scheduling of the distribution network. First, this paper proposed a specific definition of the generalized extreme value theory which is extended to the multivariate form. On this basis, the concept of tail correlation is introduced, and the tail correlation between uncertain variables on the source and load sides is calculated and analyzed. The extreme joint distribution of uncertain variables with strong correlation is fitted, and the percentile function of the joint distribution is taken to obtain the sample to construct the uncertainty set. An actual distribution network in Lu'an City, Anhui Province, is used as an example to verify the proposed approach. The results indicate that this method is able to precisely depict the uncertainty of the system, guarantee reliability, and decrease the conservatism of the scheduling plan.

articleTitle: Automatic Generation Method for High Quality Joint Inspection Points of Intelligent Equipment in Substations
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The challenges of autonomous and joint inspection of intelligent equipment, such as Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) and robots, in substations are constantly gaining attention. To efficiently capture high-quality images of power equipment, we propose a method for automatically generating joint inspection points for multiple intelligent equipment. It introduces a shooting potential model and a spatial relationship model to assess the suitability of shooting power equipment at different spatial points using various intelligent equipment. A point selection method is designed based on shooting quality constraints and spatial constraints to optimize inspection efficiency. The focus is on generating non-redundant and complete inspection points that are suitable for multiple intelligent equipment to perform with. Additionally, we study cooperative path planning of the heterogeneous robot systems to reduce the time required for the inspection task. An improved Ant-Lion Optimization Algorithm is proposed to decouple the routes of mobile robots and UAVs and plan their routes simultaneously. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated on a virtual substation experimental platform, revealing improvements in shooting quality, inspection efficiency, and reduced inspection time.

articleTitle: Study on the Factors Influencing the Induced Current of Subway Traction Network in the Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the widespread use of subway, the impact of subway on the surrounding equipment is becoming more and more serious, but in addition to the subway stray current, the induction current generated in the power system by the space time-varying magnetic field caused by the train operation is also one of the important factors threatening the safety of power transformers, and it is urgent to explore the characteristics of the influence of the subway magnetically induced current on power transformers and the influencing factors of the induced current. In this paper, we construct a simulation model of electromagnetic coupling between the traction power supply system of subway and the equivalent closed circuit of power system, verify the correctness of the simulation model by combining the time- frequency characteristics of the measured transformer neutral current, and use the model to analyze the influencing factors affecting the magnetically induced voltage.

articleTitle: A Method for Voltage Sag Source Location Based on Vague-Value Similarity
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Voltage sag causes abnormal operation of the sensitive load. Locating sag source is the basis of troubleshooting and improving power quality. The methods employed to locate the source of voltage sags rely on a physical quantity that is sensitive to the number of measurements and dependent upon the voltage sag source. A vague-set-based sag source location method is proposed. Firstly, the positive sequence set of the node voltage is calculated in different faulty lines and points, and the positive sequence components are combined with the Gauss membership function of the monitoring quantity to calculate the support degree. Secondly, the hesitancy degree and opposing degree are computed and the vague values of the faulty line can be obtained according to the support degree, hesitancy degree and opposing degree. In addition, the similarity between the vague value of each line and the reference value [1, 1] is calculated. Besides, the sag source positioning index of each line is calculated by the largest similarity value among various line faults. Finally, taking the IEEE 14 and IEEE 118 bus systems as examples, eight types of similarity definitions are used to verify the accuracy of the method. The result illustrates that the proposed method has a good performance in locating the source of voltage sag with fewer measurements and hypo-sensitivity of the voltage sag source.

articleTitle: Calculation and Verification of Line Voltage Drop and Line Loss of Low-Voltage DC Powered Lighting System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Compared with traditional low-voltage AC-powered lighting system, the low-voltage DC-powered lighting system had great advantages in safety, economy and power quality optimization. The main purpose of studying the line voltage drop and line loss calculation of the low-voltage DC-powered lighting system was to guide the engineering wiring design and engineering implementation through calculation, and to formulate a more reasonable engineering design budget. Based on the above objectives, a power supply line and load part of the low-voltage DC power supply lighting system were mathematically modeled, and the mathematical expressions of the line voltage drop and line loss were obtained through mathematical calculation. The correctness of the above mathematical expressions was verified by computer circuit simulations, and the error comparison analysis was carried out with the calculation method in the references. The error comparison analysis showed that the method in this paper had greatly reduced the calculation errors and had good versatility, which could guide the actual engineering design and implementation.

articleTitle: Construction and Weighting of Evaluation Indicators for Power Grid Reserve Projects Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process and Entropy Weight Method
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: To select projects that can improve the overall performance of the power grid, eliminate grid drawbacks, and improve the efficiency of power grid enterprises from a large number of targeted power grid reserve projects, this article establishes a comprehensive evaluation index system for reserve projects based on the effectiveness of the power grid, taking into account the characteristics of different types of reserve projects, including safety, coordination, economy, and social benefits; In response to the shortcomings of a single weighting method, a combination weighting method based on Analytic Hierarchy Process entropy weighting method is proposed based on the principle of combining subjective and objective weights. The calculation results show that the method proposed in this paper can comprehensively construct evaluation indicators and weights for reserve projects, thereby reflecting the characteristics of reserve projects. It has certain reference value and significance for the evaluation of power grid reserve projects.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Digital Grid Voice Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to help the digital grid and other typical scenarios to be implemented and promote the digital transformation of marketing, the Smart Grid Center has created an energy Internet marketing service system. With the development of the marketing service system business, the demand for voice calls using mobile handheld to communicate with electricity consumers has gradually increased. This paper uses AI technology, automatic call distribution, intelligent routing and other technologies to build a set of digital grid voice platform with features such as flexible deployment, coverage of demand, intelligent services and easy integration to meet the call demand of field operators and the needs of mobile office, to achieve customer information feedback and timely tracking of customers.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Reliability Assessment Considering Typhoon Disaster Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: To simplify the complexity of the distribution network model when typhoon hits and enhance the effectiveness of evaluating the reliability of distribution networks, the method of training long short-term memory (LSTM) with the results of mechanistic model and assessing reliability by LSTM is proposed. Firstly, the wind speed-based distribution grid element pole failure rate calculation model is proposed, through which the failure rates of distribution grid elements under different wind speeds can be calculated, based on which, a training dataset is obtained by constructing a model-driven short-term reliability assessment method that relies on sequential Monte Carlo simulation. Then, the LSTM model is constructed, and the LSTM model for mapping between system state and reliability index is obtained through offline training to achieve rapid system reliability assessment. Finally, the arithmetic example employs the IEEE-RBTS-BUS6-F4 feeder and the calculation is performed on Matlab, and the method's correctness and validity are validated by the calculation results.

articleTitle: A Study on Comprehensive Decision-Making of Pumped Storage in Capacity Planning with System Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Pumped storage power stations (PSPS) are conducive to achieving China's “dual carbon” goal. A comprehensive decision-making method of PSPS in capacity planning based on system dynamics (SD) is proposed. Firstly, based on the optimal scheduling model of wind-thermal-pumped storage hybrid system, a comprehensive evaluation index system covering economic, technical, and ecological aspects is constructed. Secondly, a comprehensive evaluation model based on SD is established considering the coupling relationship among the indexes, and entropy weight method (EWM) is adopted to determine the index weights. Finally, the analysis of the comparative testing in a modified IEEE 30-bus system verifies that the proposed method is feasible and effective. Furthermore, the test results show that the importance degree of different indexes has different impacts on the optimal decision results, which provides a reference for the capacity planning problem of PSPS in power systems containing renewable energy sources.

articleTitle: A Novel Search Coil Back-wound Permanent Magnet Synchronous Fault-tolerant Motor with Short-circuit Current Suppression Ability
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the traditional permanent magnet fault-tolerant motor has insufficient fault-tolerant ability to interturn short-circuit fault(ISCF) with few turns, a back-wound permanent magnet synchronous fault-tolerant motor with search coil is proposed in this paper. The motor has an extra search coil(SC) wound in the stator yoke, and the SC requires very few turns. After the ISCF occurs in the motor, the interturn short-circuit current(ISCC) is suppressed by passing a quantitative current into the SC. This paper first introduces the basic structure of the back-wound permanent magnet synchronous fault-tolerant motor with search coil, and then analyzes the mechanism of the ISCF suppression theoretically. Through the simulation of 1-turn, 4-turn and 8-turn short-circuit, verify the feasibility of the proposed scheme. The experimental results show that the few turns ISCC can be suppressed near the effective value by passing a quantitative current into the search coil, and the required current has nothing to do with the number of short-circuit turns, which proves the correctness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Improving the Dielectric Properties of Energy Storage Film Based on Organic Molecular Semiconductor
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The energy sector is one of our key areas of focus. Among them, dielectric film capacitors are one of the energy storage devices. Due to their many advantages, they have been widely used in many fields just like in the field of hybrid electric vehicles. There is an urgent demand to develop dielectric film capacitors with higher energy storage capacity. In this paper, in the form of all-organic composite, a small amount of organic semiconductor perylene diimide(PDI) derivative with high electron affinity(EA) was doped into polycarbonate(PC) matrix to improve the breakdown strength. In this way, the energy storage density of dielectric film capacitors will be effectively improved. First of all, the structure of molecular semiconductor perylene diimide derivative and its influence on the chemical structure of PC matrix were characterized by infrared spectroscopy. In order to explore the effect of organic semiconductor doping on the dielectric properties of PC composite films, the dielectric parameters with frequency variation and DC breakdown strength were mainly tested and analyzed. After doping a small amount of perylene diimide derivative with different contents, the dielectric constant of PC composite films has increased to some extent. It is worth stating that the increase of dielectric loss is not significant, which is within an acceptable range. In addition, the DC breakdown test results show that the dielectric film sample doped with 0.001mmol/g perylene diimide derivative can reach 720 MV/m. This is 17% higher than that of pure PC film. Therefore, based on theoretical calculations, the maximum energy storage density at 50Hz will be 1.48 times that of pure PC film.

articleTitle: Digital Twin-Based Model of Battery Energy Storage Systems for SOC Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The battery energy storage system is a complex and non-linear multi-parameter system, where uncertainties of key parameters and variations in individual batteries seriously affect the reliability, safety and efficiency of the system. To address this issue, a digital twin-based SOC evaluation method for battery energy storage systems is proposed in this paper. This method enables accurate state estimation of the SOC, mitigates safety hazards and prevents unforeseen system failures. By utilizing digital twin technology, Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Bi-Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) neural network are integrated to develop multiple neural network fusion methods, and the split-band prediction is further used to improve SOC prediction accuracy. The proposed method effectively overcomes the limitations of single prediction method for different research subjects, which can provide decision support for accurate SOC assessment and ensure optimal performance and safe operation of the battery energy storage system.

articleTitle: Impact of Wind-Solar-Storage System Operation Characteristics on the Peak-Valley-Difference of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In the context of new power system construction, the proportion of wind power (WP) and photovoltaic (PV) connected to the grid continues to increase, in order to improve the utilization rate of WP and PV, and reduce the impact of solar power fluctuations on the power system and the occupation of system flexibility resources, so the complementarity of WP and PV in time and space is used, and the ES of response power and capacity is installed to reduce the peak-valley-difference (PVD) of power grid. Firstly, the framework and operation mode of wind-solar-storage combined power generation system (WSS-CPGS) are described. Secondly, a multi-objective optimization model is constructed to reduce the output fluctuation and the maximum PVD of the WSS-CPGS, and the multi-objective weighting method and operation constraints are proposed. Finally, a numerical example is set to verify that the optimization model can effectively reduce the output fluctuation and the maximum PVD of the system. At the same time, the influence of energy storage power and capacity configuration on the WSS-CPGS is obtained through the analysis of examples.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Analysis of WTs Based on VSG-PMSG Considering the Machine-Side Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Wind turbines (WTs) using virtual synchronous generator (VSG) technology can effectively improve the voltage/frequency support capability of power grid. But it also brings complex transient stability problems due to dynamic interaction between machine-side and grid-side. In this paper, the transient stability of WTs based on permanent magnet synchronous generator with VSG control (VSG-PMSG) is investigated considering machine-side rotor dynamics. The transient model of VSG-PMSG is first established and then the dynamic response of the VSG-PMSG under frequency fluctuation is analyzed. And excessive damping coefficient or severe frequency drop will increase the risk of synchronous instability of the VSG-PMSG. Moreover, the transient characteristics of VSG-PMSG under voltage drop have also been studied. And the machine-side dynamics will reduce the transient stability margin of VSG-PMSG by changing the acceleration and deceleration area. Finally, the time-domain simulations based on MATLAB/Simulink are given to verify the correctness of the stability analysis.

articleTitle: Low Carbon Optimal Dispatch of Integrated Energy System Considering Power to Hydrogen Equipment and Stepped Carbon Trading
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: As integrated energy systems increasingly evolve, how to reduce carbon emissions from human production and life has become an important issue. To address the problem that the operators consider the dispatching of the system more from the perspective of economic benefits, which leads to high carbon emissions, a scheme for the construction of integrated energy systems and optimal dispatching considering the power to hydrogen equipment and stepped carbon trading is proposed. First, the power to hydrogen equipment is modeled, and its energy conversion relationship is analyzed. Then, the authors measure the carbon emission by carbon trading cost and introduce the principle of stepped carbon trading. Finally, a low-carbon optimization dispatching method is proposed. The comparison shows that the model considering stepped carbon trading can reduce carbon emission costs. Furthermore, it can reduce the daily operation cost of the system. Power to hydrogen equipment can promote the decrease of daily operation costs and reduce the demand for purchased energy at the peak of electricity consumption.

articleTitle: Construction of Knowledge Graph for Substation Automation Equipment Ledger Based on Neo4j Graph Database
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Substation automation equipment, as a key link in the energy internet, plays an significant role in achieving grid operation control and providing real-time and reliable measurement data. However, with the increase in the number of substations and the promotion of the unattended mode, the operation and maintenance of substation automation equipment is becoming increasingly heavy. Therefore, simplifying the complexity of operation and maintenance through digital technology and reduce the workload of personnel is significant. Among this article, the knowledge graph is applied to process the ledger information of substation automation equipment. By constructing a variety of redundant equipment information into a knowledge graph, the work efficiency of equipment information query and identification is significantly improved, and it can provide the vital assistance for the realization of automatic operation and maintenance of substations.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization for Dynamic VAR Planning based on Power System Partitioning Method
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Dynamic VAR compensation can effectively improve the voltage stability in the environment of the increased induction loads and renewable energy penetration with the rapid development of industry and economy. This paper proposes a multi-objective optimization for dynamic VAR planning based on the power system partitioning method. Firstly, a novel power system partitioning approach considering the electrical distance and transient characteristics is proposed to reduce the dimensions of installation locations and capacity of STATCOM. Then, the optimal candidate buses installed the STATCOMs are determined by the voltage control index at every zone. Thirdly, a multi-objective dynamic VAR planning model is constructed with three sub-objectives: 1) total planning cost; 2) <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$L$</tex> index; 3) transient voltage severity index TVSI.
